idioms.example_en: He had no prepared remarks, so he delivered the entire speech off the cuff.
idioms.example_zh: 他没有任何现成的发言稿，整场演讲全凭即兴发挥。

idioms.meaning: 非正式地；不公开引用的
idioms.example_en: The diplomat shared some critical background details strictly off the record.
idioms.example_zh: 这位外交官严格以非公开方式透露了一些关键背景细节。

collocations.example_en: With lower taxes and cheaper rent, you would be much better off living here.
collocations.example_zh: 税率更低、房租更便宜，你住在这里生活境况会好得多。

collocations.example_en: His family is well off enough to send all three children to private school.
collocations.example_zh: 他的家庭相当富裕，足以供三个孩子全念私立学校。

collocations.example_en: It has been raining off and on all morning.
collocations.example_zh: 整个上午雨都在断断续续地下着。

idioms.meaning: 保持静止不动
idioms.example_en: Please hold still for a second while I take the photo.
idioms.example_zh: 请保持别动，我这就给你拍张照片。

idioms.meaning: 静水流深；大智若愚（指看似寡言内向者往往深藏不露）
idioms.example_en: He rarely speaks in meetings, but still waters run deep—his ideas are brilliant.
idioms.example_zh: 他在会上很少发言，但静水流深，他的见解其实非常独到。

collocations.example_en: The doctor's reassuring words helped still her growing fears about the surgery.
collocations.example_zh: 医生宽慰的话语有助于平息她对这场手术日益加重的恐惧。

collocations.example_en: Technology moves rapidly; if you refuse to learn, you simply cannot stand still.
collocations.example_zh: 技术日新月异，如果你拒绝学习，就绝不可能在原地维持现状。

collocations.phrase: in the still of the night
collocations.example_en: A distant siren broke through the still of the night.
collocations.example_zh: 远处的警笛声打破了夜的沉寂。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 斥责，训斥
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The manager told him off in front of his peers for being repeatedly late.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 经理当着同事们的面严厉训斥了他屡次迟到的行为。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 分辨；区分（两者之间的不同）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The identical twins look so alike that even their classmates cannot tell them apart.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 这对同卵双胞胎长得太像了，连同班同学都分不清他们谁是谁。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 告发，打小报告；对……产生不良显现/显露疲态
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The heavy workload is beginning to tell on his physical health.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 沉重的工作负荷正开始对他的身体健康产生明显的负面影响。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 把……和……区别开来
phrasal_verbs.example_en: How can you tell an authentic leather jacket from an artificial one?
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 你怎么区分一件真皮夹克与仿皮夹克？

idioms.meaning: 时间会给出答案；岁月会证明
idioms.example_en: Whether the merger was a strategic success remains to be seen—time will tell.
idioms.example_zh: 这次并购是否算得上战略成功尚无定论，时间会证明一切。

idioms.meaning: 很难说；世事难料
idioms.example_en: Take an umbrella with you—you can never tell with this fickle weather.
idioms.example_zh: 带上伞吧——这多变的天气谁也说不准。

idioms.meaning: 听我说；这样吧（提出建议或折中方案）
idioms.example_en: Tell you what, let's split the bill evenly this evening.
idioms.example_zh: 这样吧，今晚这顿饭咱们俩平摊。

collocations.example_en: To tell the truth, I was not particularly impressed by his presentation.
collocations.example_zh: 坦白说，我对他的演示汇报并没有留下太深的印象。

collocations.example_en: Most casual coffee drinkers cannot tell the difference between these two blends.
collocations.example_zh: 大多数普通咖啡饮用者分辨不出这两种拼配豆的区别。

collocations.example_en: He looked straight into my eyes and told an outright lie.
collocations.example_zh: 他直视着我的眼睛，说了个彻头彻尾的谎话。

idioms.meaning: 处于领先地位；占得先机
idioms.example_en: By completing the research early, our team stayed well ahead of the game.
idioms.example_zh: 提前完成了研究工作，使我们团队始终占据着先机。

idioms.meaning: 把戏露馅了；大势已去，败局已定
idioms.example_en: When the police surrounded the hideout, the thieves knew the game was up.
idioms.example_zh: 当警方包围藏匿点时，窃贼们知道大势已去了。

idioms.meaning: 任何人皆可攻击/批评的对象；合法猎物
idioms.example_en: Public figures must accept that their private lives are often considered fair game by the press.
idioms.example_zh: 公众人物必须接受这样一个事实：他们的私生活往往被媒体视为可以随意报道的对象。

collocations.meaning: 钻系统空子；利用规则漏洞谋利
collocations.example_en: Some traders devised sophisticated algorithms to game the financial system.
collocations.example_zh: 一些交易员设计了复杂的算法来钻金融系统的漏洞牟利。

collocations.example_en: Let's review our negotiation game plan before stepping into the conference room.
collocations.example_zh: 在走进会议室之前，我们先过一遍谈判的行动方案。

collocations.meaning: 走漏风声；泄露底细/秘密
collocations.example_en: Her nervous smile immediately gave the game away.
collocations.example_zh: 她那紧张的一笑立刻泄露了秘密。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 渴望，盼望得到
phrasal_verbs.example_en: After months of isolation in the arctic outpost, he longed for human company.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在北极哨所与世隔绝数月后，他极度渴望有人陪伴。

idioms.meaning: 从长远来看；终究
idioms.example_en: Investing in renewable energy will save both money and resources in the long run.
idioms.example_zh: 从长远来看，投资可再生能源不仅节约资金，还能节省资源。

idioms.meaning: 胜算不大的尝试；希望渺茫的事物
idioms.example_en: Getting accepted into Harvard is a long shot, but she submitted her application anyway.
idioms.example_zh: 被哈佛大学录取希望十分渺茫，但她无论如何还是递交了申请。

idioms.meaning: 年纪偏大；老化过时
idioms.example_en: That computer system is getting a bit long in the tooth and needs replacing.
idioms.example_zh: 那套电脑系统有些过于陈旧，需要进行更换了。

collocations.example_en: She longed to return to her hometown after spending a decade abroad.
collocations.example_zh: 在海外度过十年之后，她渴望重返故土。

collocations.example_en: You can borrow the laptop so long as you return it before Friday.
collocations.example_zh: 只要你在周五之前归还，这台笔记本电脑你可以拿去借用。

collocations.meaning: 在……之前很久 / 在……之后很久
collocations.example_en: Ancient astronomers tracked celestial cycles long before telescopes were invented.
collocations.example_zh: 早在望远镜发明之前很久，古代天文学家就已经在追踪天体运行规律了。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 起初打算；动身出发；创业起步
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He started out as an entry-level clerk and eventually became the company CEO.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他起初只是一名基层文员，最终成长为了公司的首席执行官。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 以……开始；着手进行；启程
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The speaker started off with a humorous anecdote to put the audience at ease.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 演讲者以一则幽默轶事开场，让观众放松下来。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 启动（机器或汽车）；创办（新企业）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: She secured venture funding to start up a biotechnology laboratory.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 她获得了风险投资，创办了一家生物技术实验室。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 从头重新开始
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The computer crashed before I saved my draft, forcing me to start over.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 电脑在我保存草稿之前死机了，迫使我不得不从头重来。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 开始唠叨/训斥某人；着手处理某项繁重任务
phrasal_verbs.example_en: As soon as he walked through the door, his father started in on his grades.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他刚踏进家门，父亲就抓着他的成绩开始喋喋不休地训话。

idioms.meaning: 从零开始；白手起家
idioms.example_en: When their factory burned down, the founders had to start from scratch.
idioms.example_zh: 当他们的工厂被大火焚毁后，创始人不得不从零开始重新创业。

idioms.meaning: 抢先一步；赢得先发优势
idioms.example_en: Waking up at dawn allowed us to get a head start on the interstate traffic.
idioms.example_zh: 黎明破晓时起床让我们抢占了先机，避开了州际公路上的拥堵。

idioms.meaning: 既往不咎；洗心革面重新开始
idioms.example_en: Moving to a new city allowed her to start with a clean slate.
idioms.example_zh: 搬到一座全新的城市让她得以抛却过往，翻开生活的新篇章。

collocations.example_en: He offered to share his snacks as a way to start a conversation with the stranger.
collocations.example_zh: 他主动分享零食，以此作为与那位陌生人开启交谈的契机。

collocations.example_en: They bought a larger house in the suburbs when they decided to start a family.
collocations.example_zh: 当他们决定生儿育女组建家庭时，在郊区购置了一处更大的房子。

collocations.example_en: He turned the key in the ignition, but the cold engine refused to start.
collocations.example_zh: 他转动点火钥匙，但在严寒之下引擎怎么也发动不起来。

idioms.meaning: 陪伴某人
idioms.example_en: I'll stay and keep you company while you wait for the train.
idioms.example_zh: 你在等火车的时候，我留下来陪你吧。

idioms.meaning: 分道扬镳；终止合作；（意见）产生分歧
idioms.example_en: The band decided to part company due to creative differences.
idioms.example_zh: 由于创作理念不合，乐队决定分道扬镳。

idioms.meaning: （因有许多人面临同样处境而）并不孤单
idioms.example_en: If you failed the exam, you are in good company; half the class did too.
idioms.example_zh: 如果你这次考试没及格，你也别难过，全班有一半人都没过。

collocations.example_en: They spent hours talking, genuinely enjoying each other's company.
collocations.example_zh: 他们聊了几个小时，真心享受彼此相伴的时光。

collocations.example_en: The currency fell in company with most other emerging-market currencies.
collocations.example_zh: 该国货币与大多数其他新兴市场货币一同贬值。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 居高临下地对…说话；傲慢对待
phrasal_verbs.example_en: She hates the way her boss constantly talks down to his assistants.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 她很讨厌老板总是用居高临下的口气对助理说话。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 顶嘴；反唇相讥
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Children should be encouraged to express themselves, but not to talk back disrespectfully.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 应当鼓励孩子表达观点，但不应放任他们毫无礼貌地顶嘴。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 说服…做某事；劝服
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Her friends managed to talk her into joining the volunteer program.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 她的朋友们设法劝服了她加入这个志愿者项目。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 劝阻…不做某事；打消…的念头
phrasal_verbs.example_en: We tried to talk him out of resigning, but his mind was made up.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我们试图劝他打消辞职的念头，但他已下定决心。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 商量；详细讨论
phrasal_verbs.example_en: You need to sit down and talk over this issue before making a final decision.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在做出最终决定之前，你们需要坐下来把这个问题好好商量一下。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 通盘梳理；详细讨论以消除疑虑
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Let me talk you through the onboarding procedure step by step.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 让我一步步带你梳理一遍入职流程。

idioms.meaning: 三句话不离本行；在社交场合大谈工作业务
idioms.example_en: Even at dinner parties, the software engineers couldn't stop talking shop.
idioms.example_zh: 即便在晚宴上，那些软件工程师们也总是三句话不离本行。

idioms.meaning: 街头巷尾议论的焦点；风靡一时的人或事物
idioms.example_en: Her daring performance at the gala quickly became the talk of the town.
idioms.example_zh: 她在晚会上的惊艳表演迅速成为全城热议的焦点。

idioms.meaning: 金钱万能；有钱能使鬼推磨
idioms.example_en: In the world of high finance, money talks more loudly than pedigree.
idioms.example_zh: 在高端金融界，金钱比家世出身更有话语权。

collocations.example_en: He made awkward small talk with the guests while waiting for the host.
collocations.example_zh: 在等待主人时，他尴尬地与宾客们寒暄了几句。

collocations.meaning: 直言不讳；坦诚直率的话
collocations.example_en: The voters appreciated her straight talk on the state of the economy.
collocations.example_zh: 选民们赞赏她就经济现状所作出的坦率直言。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 取得成功；得到回报；付清；付清报酬解雇
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Years of relentless training finally paid off when she won the gold medal.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 多年坚持不懈的训练终于得到了回报，她斩获了金牌。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 偿还欠款；报复/回敬
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I promise to pay you back as soon as my next paycheck arrives.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我保证下个月薪水一到账就马上把钱还你。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 付清欠款；全额付款（常指勉强或被催促）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The landlord threatened to take legal action if they didn't pay up.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 房东威胁说，如果他们还不结清房租，就将采取法律手段。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 大笔支付；付出巨款
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Insurance companies have paid out millions in flood damage claims.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 保险公司已经为洪水灾害理赔支付了数百万美元。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 为…付款；为（错误行为）付出代价
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He was careless, and eventually he paid for it with his reputation.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他行事粗心大意，最终为此付出了名誉的代价。

idioms.meaning: 付出过高的代价；被痛宰
idioms.example_en: Tourists often pay through the nose for basic amenities near famous landmarks.
idioms.example_zh: 游客在著名地标附近往往要为基本生活用品付出高昂的冤枉钱。

idioms.meaning: 口头应付；光说不做
idioms.example_en: Many corporations pay lip service to sustainability without taking real action.
idioms.example_zh: 许多企业只是在口头上支持可持续发展，却未采取任何实际行动。

idioms.meaning: 承担后果；自食其果
idioms.example_en: After years of reckless borrowing, the country now has to pay the piper.
idioms.example_zh: 经过多年的肆意借贷，该国如今必须承担恶果。

collocations.example_en: Please pay close attention to the safety instructions demonstrated on board.
collocations.example_zh: 请仔细留意机上演示的安全须知。

collocations.example_en: Thousands gathered in the town square to pay their respects to the late leader.
collocations.example_zh: 成千上万的人聚集在城市广场，向已故领袖致哀。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 约（某人）出去；约会
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He finally gathered the courage to ask her out for coffee.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他终于鼓起勇气约她出去喝杯咖啡。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 四处打听；多方询问
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I'll ask around and see if anyone knows of an available apartment.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我会到处打听一下，看有没有人知道哪里有空房出租。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 要求；索取；招惹（麻烦/批评）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Driving at that speed on icy roads is simply asking for trouble.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在结冰的路面上开那么快纯粹是自找麻烦。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 问候；探询（健康或近况）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: She called this morning to ask after your grandmother's health.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 她今天早晨打电话来询问你祖母的身体状况。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 邀请（某人）到家中
phrasal_verbs.example_en: We should ask the new neighbors over for dinner this weekend.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我们这周末应该请新搬来的邻居到家里吃顿晚饭。

idioms.meaning: 唾手可得；只要索取即可得到
idioms.example_en: With his outstanding credentials, the executive position was his for the asking.
idioms.example_zh: 凭他出众的资历，那个高管职位对他而言唾手可得。

idioms.meaning: 想入非非；提非分要求
idioms.example_en: Expecting a luxury apartment at that price is asking for the moon.
idioms.example_zh: 指望以那个价格买到豪宅无异于异想天开。

collocations.example_en: You must ask permission from the authorities before filming in this area.
collocations.example_zh: 在该区域拍摄之前，必须先获得主管部门的许可。

collocations.example_en: May I ask a favour of you to proofread my cover letter?
collocations.example_zh: 能麻烦你帮个忙，替我校对一下求职信吗？

idioms.meaning: 与…相去甚远；大相径庭
idioms.example_en: The modest hotel was a far cry from the luxurious resort promised in the brochure.
idioms.example_zh: 那家简陋的旅馆与宣传册上承诺的奢华度假村相去甚远。

idioms.meaning: 到处；四面八方
idioms.example_en: People traveled from far and wide to attend the annual music festival.
idioms.example_zh: 人们从四面八方赶来参加这一年一度的音乐节。

idioms.meaning: 做得太过分；过火
idioms.example_en: His teasing went too far when he started mocking her personal struggles.
idioms.example_zh: 当他开始嘲弄她的个人难处时，他的玩笑就开得太过分了。

collocations.example_en: So far, researchers have found no evidence linking the drug to long-term side effects.
collocations.example_zh: 迄今为止，研究人员尚未发现该药物与长期副作用之间存在关联的证据。

collocations.example_en: The new policy is far from perfect, but it is an improvement over the previous one.
collocations.example_zh: 这项新政策远非完美，但比起之前的政策已有所改进。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （人或物）发生…情况；遭受…命运（常用于疑问句）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Whatever became of that brilliant young artist we met in Paris?
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我们在巴黎遇到的那个才华横溢的年轻艺术家后来怎么样了？

idioms.meaning: 成为习惯；熟能生巧；习以为常
idioms.example_en: After months of practice, checking the instruments became second nature to the pilot.
idioms.example_zh: 经过数月的练习，检查仪表已成为飞行员的下意识习惯。

collocations.example_en: Physical media formats quickly became obsolete with the advent of digital streaming.
collocations.example_zh: 随着数字化流媒体的到来，实体媒介格式迅速被淘汰。

collocations.example_en: Through relentless innovation, commercial space travel is beginning to become reality.
collocations.example_zh: 通过持续不断的创新，商业太空旅行正在逐步成为现实。

collocations.example_en: Consumers have become acutely aware of data privacy issues in recent years.
collocations.example_zh: 近年来，消费者已高度警觉到数据隐私问题。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 把…列为…之一；跻身于
phrasal_verbs.example_en: She numbers among the most influential contemporary architects in the country.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 她是该国最具影响力的当代建筑大师之一。

idioms.meaning: 时日无多；气数已尽
idioms.example_en: With profits plummeting, the embattled CEO's days at the firm are numbered.
idioms.example_zh: 随着利润暴跌，这位陷入困境的首席执行官在公司的日子屈指可数了。

idioms.meaning: 按部就班；机械刻板地
idioms.example_en: The mystery thriller followed a strictly by-the-numbers plot with few surprises.
idioms.example_zh: 这部悬疑惊悚片剧情完全按部就班，几乎没有任何悬念。

collocations.example_en: A growing number of professionals choose to work remotely from home.
collocations.example_zh: 越来越多的职场人士选择居家远程办公。

collocations.example_en: Ensuring the safety of our passengers is our number one priority.
collocations.example_zh: 确保乘客的安全是我们的第一要务。

idioms.meaning: 心满意足；非常高兴
idioms.example_en: She was pleased as Punch when she saw her daughter graduate with honors.
idioms.example_zh: 看到女儿以优异成绩毕业，她高兴得合不拢嘴。

idioms.meaning: 随你便；悉听尊便
idioms.example_en: You can arrange the furniture as you please in your new studio.
idioms.example_zh: 你可以根据自己的喜好随意布置新单身公寓里的家具。

collocations.example_en: The food critic is notoriously hard to please, even with top-rated restaurants.
collocations.example_zh: 这位美食评论家以挑剔著称，哪怕是对顶级餐厅也不例外。

collocations.meaning: 竭诚服务；旨在令人满意
collocations.example_en: The boutique hotel aims to please with highly personalized guest services.
collocations.example_zh: 这家精品酒店旨在通过高度个性化的宾客服务赢得顾客满意。

collocations.example_en: If you don't want to come with us, you can please yourself.
collocations.example_zh: 如果你不想和我们一起去，你就悉听尊便吧。

idioms.meaning: 听候某人吩咐；随时效劳
idioms.example_en: The concierge bowed politely and said, 'We are always at your service, madam.'
idioms.example_zh: 礼宾员礼貌地鞠躬说道：“夫人，我们随时听候您的吩咐。”

idioms.meaning: 临时征用；应急使用
idioms.example_en: During the blizzard, private tractors were pressed into service to clear the roads.
idioms.example_zh: 在暴风雪期间，私人拖拉机被临时征用来清理道路。

collocations.example_en: Developing nations struggle to service their external debts amidst rising interest rates.
collocations.example_zh: 在利率上升的背景下，发展中国家艰难地偿还其外债本息。

collocations.meaning: （送去机械、车辆）进行常规检修维护
collocations.example_en: You ought to have your car serviced before setting off on a long road trip.
collocations.example_zh: 在踏上自驾长途旅行前，你最好把车送去保养检修一下。

collocations.example_en: Investing in prompt customer service significantly boosts brand loyalty.
collocations.example_zh: 投资于高效及时的客户服务能显著提升品牌忠诚度。

idioms.meaning: 支持；拥护；作为…的佐证
idioms.example_en: The researcher presented overwhelming data in support of the new hypothesis.
idioms.example_zh: 研究人员提出了压倒性的数据来支持这一新假说。

idioms.meaning: 精神支持；道义声援
idioms.example_en: His family came to the courtroom solely to provide moral support.
idioms.example_zh: 他的家人出庭完全是为了给他提供精神上的支持。

collocations.example_en: The trade union strongly supports the proposed increase in the minimum wage.
collocations.example_zh: 工会坚决支持关于提高最低工资的提案。

collocations.example_en: Working two part-time jobs was barely enough to support his family.
collocations.example_zh: 打两份兼职的收入勉强够他养家糊口。

collocations.example_en: Without ongoing financial support from sponsors, the festival cannot proceed.
collocations.example_zh: 如果没有赞助商持续的资金支持，该艺术节将无法继续举办。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 畅所欲言；展现机会；开放营业
phrasal_verbs.example_en: It took months before she finally felt safe enough to open up about her childhood.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 过了好几个月，她才终于感到足够安全，开始敞开心扉谈起自己的童年。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 展开；变宽；变得开朗
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Beyond the narrow canyon, the river opens out into a wide valley.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 穿过狭窄的峡谷后，河流变宽，汇入一片开阔的河谷。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 通向；朝向
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The French doors in the living room open onto a sunny terrace.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 客厅的法式落地门通向一个阳光充足的露台。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 以…开场/开始
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The speaker opened with a humorous anecdote to break the ice.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 演讲者以一段幽默的轶事开场以活跃气氛。

idioms.meaning: 引发一连串棘手难题；捅马蜂窝
idioms.example_en: Revisiting the budget allocation at this stage will open a can of worms.
idioms.example_zh: 现阶段重新审查预算分配会捅出一堆意想不到的麻烦。

idioms.meaning: 为…创造机会/铺平道路
idioms.example_en: A master's degree from a top university can open doors for your future career.
idioms.example_zh: 名牌大学的硕士学位能为你的未来职业生涯敞开大门。

idioms.meaning: 留心；保持警惕
idioms.example_en: Keep your eyes open for any potential signs of market volatility.
idioms.example_zh: 密切留意市场波动的任何潜在迹象。

collocations.example_en: You need two forms of identification to open a bank account.
collocations.example_zh: 开立银行账户需要两种身份证明文件。

collocations.example_en: The federal agency decided to open an inquiry into the data breach.
collocations.example_zh: 该联邦机构决定对数据泄露事件展开正式调查。

collocations.example_en: The government's proposal opened a fierce debate on public spending.
collocations.example_zh: 政府的提议引发了一场关于公共支出的激烈辩论。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 建立；安装/调试；陷害
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The tech firm set up a new research facility in Singapore.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 这家科技公司在新加坡设立了一个新的研发基地。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 动身出发；触发/引发；衬托
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The abrupt announcement set off a wave of panic selling in the stock market.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 突如其来的公告在股市中引发了一波恐慌性抛售。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 动身启程；着手进行；清晰陈述
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The report sets out a comprehensive strategy for economic recovery.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 该报告清晰阐述了一套全面的经济复苏策略。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （恶劣气候、不快情绪等）开始并可能持续
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Winter has firmly set in, bringing freezing temperatures across the region.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 寒冬已然降临，给整个地区带来了严寒天气。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 留出/省出；暂不考虑/搁置
phrasal_verbs.example_en: We should set aside our personal differences and focus on the common goal.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我们应该搁置个人分歧，把精力集中在共同目标上。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 阻碍/推迟；使花费巨资
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The sudden supply chain disruption set back the launch date by three months.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 供应链的突然中断使产品发布日期推迟了三个月。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 着手处理；开始做
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Immediately after the meeting, the engineers set about fixing the security flaw.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 会议结束后，工程师们立刻着手修复安全漏洞。

idioms.meaning: 为…铺平道路；为…创造条件
idioms.example_en: The breakthrough treaty set the stage for long-term peace in the region.
idioms.example_zh: 这项突破性条约为该地区的长期和平奠定了基础。

idioms.meaning: 一心渴望；铁了心要
idioms.example_en: She had set her heart on studying architecture in Paris.
idioms.example_zh: 她一心渴望去巴黎学习建筑学。

idioms.meaning: 成定局；不可更改
idioms.example_en: These project timelines are tentative and by no means set in stone.
idioms.example_zh: 这些项目时间表只是暂定的，绝非不可更改。

collocations.example_en: The athlete set a world record in the 100-meter sprint.
collocations.example_zh: 该运动员在百米短跑中打破了世界纪录。

collocations.example_en: The company has set an ambitious goal to reach net-zero emissions by 2030.
collocations.example_zh: 公司确立了到2030年实现净零排放的宏伟目标。

collocations.example_en: Senior executives need to set a positive example of workplace ethics.
collocations.example_zh: 高管需要树立积极的职场道德榜样。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 搞砸；弄坏；造成身心伤害（俚语）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I really fucked up my chances of getting promoted by missing that deadline.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我错过了那个截止日期，彻底搞砸了自己的晋升机会。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 滚开；走开（粗俗语）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He told the aggressive heckler to fuck off.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他让那个咄咄逼人的捣乱分子滚开。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 胡闹；鬼混；瞎折腾（俚语）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Stop fucking around and get back to work before the boss comes in.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 别胡闹了，老板进来前赶紧回去干活。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 招惹；戏弄；乱动（俚语）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Don't fuck with the wiring unless you know exactly what you're doing.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 除非你非常清楚自己在干嘛，否则别瞎动那些电线。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 坑害；欺骗/算计某人（俚语）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: They felt completely fucked over when their business partner took the money and vanished.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 当合伙人卷款潜逃时，他们感觉自己被彻彻底底坑惨了。

idioms.meaning: 毫不在乎；根本无所谓（粗俗语）
idioms.example_en: He acts like he doesn't give a fuck about what anyone thinks of him.
idioms.example_zh: 他表现得好像根本不在乎别人怎么看他。

idioms.meaning: 搞什么鬼；到底怎么回事（粗俗感叹语）
idioms.example_en: What the fuck happened to the server while I was away?
idioms.example_zh: 我不在的时候服务器到底搞什么鬼出问题了？

collocations.meaning: 去他的；算了（俚语表放弃或孤注一掷）
collocations.example_en: Fuck it, let's just book the tickets and worry about the money later.
collocations.example_zh: 去他的，我们先把票订了，钱的事以后再说。

collocations.meaning: 彻底搞砸；捅大篓子（口语高频）
collocations.example_en: The PR department fucked up royally with that insensitive tweet.
collocations.example_zh: 公关部发的那条毫无同理心的推文彻底把事情搞砸了。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 聚集在一起；将…归为一组
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The students grouped together to brainstorm solutions for the case study.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 学生们聚在一起为案例研究进行头脑风暴。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 把…分类/划分为
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The survey respondents were grouped into three distinct demographic segments.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 调查受访者被划分为三个不同的群体。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 围拢在…周围
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Curious onlookers quickly grouped around the street performers.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 好奇的围观者很快聚集在街头艺人周围。

collocations.example_en: The artifacts in the museum are grouped by historical period.
collocations.example_zh: 博物馆中的文物是按历史时期分类陈列的。

collocations.example_en: Data entries were grouped according to their country of origin.
collocations.example_zh: 数据条目根据来源国进行了归类分组。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 借调；外派（英式公文/职场高频：second sb to sth）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: She was seconded to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs for a two-year assignment.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 她被借调到外交部任职两年。

collocations.meaning: 附议（动议）；正式赞同提案
collocations.example_en: The committee chairman asked if anyone would second the motion.
collocations.example_zh: 委员会主席询问是否有人附议这项动议。

collocations.example_en: I am delighted to second the nomination of Dr. Smith for board president.
collocations.example_zh: 我很高兴附议提名史密斯博士担任董事会主席。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 与…正式会晤；遭遇/受到（反应、困难等）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The prime minister will meet with international delegates tomorrow.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 首相明天将与国际代表团正式会晤。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 碰头；聚会
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Let's meet up for coffee sometime next week to catch up.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 下周找个时间一起喝杯咖啡聚聚吧。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 相互妥协；折中相就
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Both parties must be willing to meet halfway if negotiations are to succeed.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 谈判若要取得成功，双方都必须愿意做出妥协。

idioms.meaning: 维持生计；收支相抵
idioms.example_en: Many families are struggling to make ends meet due to rising inflation.
idioms.example_zh: 由于通胀上升，许多家庭都在勉力维持生计。

idioms.meaning: 另有隐情；不仅是表面所见
idioms.example_en: There is definitely more to this political scandal than meets the eye.
idioms.example_zh: 这桩政治丑闻背后绝对另有隐情，绝非表面那么简单。

idioms.meaning: 与某人目光相接
idioms.example_en: He felt guilty and could hardly bring himself to meet her eye.
idioms.example_zh: 他感到内疚，几乎不敢直视她的眼睛。

collocations.example_en: The team worked overtime throughout the weekend to meet the critical deadline.
collocations.example_zh: 整个周末团队都在加班，以赶上这个至关重要的截止日期。

collocations.example_en: The applicant failed to meet the minimum educational requirements.
collocations.example_zh: 申请人未达到最低学历要求。

collocations.example_en: The city's healthcare infrastructure proved resilient enough to meet the challenge.
collocations.example_zh: 事实证明，该市的医疗基础设施具备足够的韧性来应对挑战。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 逐步建立/积聚；增强（体质/信心）；大肆宣传/造势
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Regular exercise helps build up your immune system against seasonal viruses.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 经常锻炼有助于增强免疫系统以抵御季节性病毒。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 以…为基础发展；巩固
phrasal_verbs.example_en: We should build on the success of our pilot program to expand nationwide.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我们应当在试点项目的成功基础之上，向全国推广。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 将…纳入/内置；使成为固定组成部分
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Contingency measures must be built into the project budget from the outset.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 从一开始就必须将应急预案纳入项目预算之中。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 扩建；全面开发；扩展（基础设施或业务）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Telecom operators are accelerating efforts to build out their 5G networks.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 电信运营商正在加快扩建5G网络的步伐。

idioms.meaning: 建立纽带；架起沟通桥梁；消除分歧
idioms.example_en: Diplomats worked tirelessly to build bridges between the warring factions.
idioms.example_zh: 外交官们孜孜不倦地努力，在交战派系之间架起沟通与和解的桥梁。

idioms.meaning: 做白日梦；构想空中楼阁
idioms.example_en: Instead of building castles in the air, you should devise an actionable business plan.
idioms.example_zh: 与其建空中楼阁白日做梦，你不如制定一个切实可行的商业计划。

collocations.example_en: Transparency in corporate governance is essential to build investor trust.
collocations.example_zh: 公司治理的透明度对于树立投资者信任至关重要。

collocations.example_en: It takes years to build a strong professional relationship, but seconds to ruin it.
collocations.example_zh: 建立牢固的职业关系需要数年时间，但毁掉它只需几秒钟。

collocations.example_en: The committee leader managed to build consensus among diverging stakeholders.
collocations.example_zh: 委员会负责人成功在意见相左的利益相关者之间凝聚了共识。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 照料/看护；喜欢；愿意
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He took a sabbatical leave to care for his elderly parents at home.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他休了公假，在家里照料年迈的双亲。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 关心；在乎；计较
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Consumers increasingly care about the environmental footprint of the products they buy.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 消费者越来越在乎所购产品对环境造成的影响。

idioms.meaning: 根本不在乎；毫不在意
idioms.example_en: She could not care less about the gossip circulating around the office.
idioms.example_zh: 她对办公室里流传的八卦流言根本毫不在意。

idioms.meaning: 想要/愿意做某事（常用于客气提问或邀请）
idioms.example_en: Would you care to join us for dinner after the lecture?
idioms.example_zh: 讲座结束后您愿意和我们一起共进晚餐吗？

collocations.example_en: She cares deeply about social justice and human rights issues.
collocations.example_zh: 她极其关注社会公平与人权问题。

collocations.example_en: Don't worry about the reservations; our assistant will take care of everything.
collocations.example_zh: 别担心预订的事，我们的助理会处理好一切。

collocations.example_en: These delicate negotiations must be handled with the utmost care.
collocations.example_zh: 这些微妙的谈判必须极其谨慎地对待。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 握紧；稍等（电话等）；坚持住
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Hold on a second while I transfer your call to customer service.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 请稍候片刻，我这就把您的电话转接给客服。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 举起；支撑；延误/阻碍；持械抢劫
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Construction was held up for three weeks due to severe flooding.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 由于严重水灾，施工被延误了整整三周。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 伸出；抵挡/坚持；抱有（希望）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Doctors hold out little hope of a full recovery given the severity of the injury.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 鉴于伤势极其严重，医生们对完全康复不抱太大希望。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 克制/抑制（情感）；隐瞒；阻碍发展
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He could barely hold back his tears upon hearing the tragic news.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 听到这个噩耗，他几乎忍不住要流下泪来。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 推迟/延迟；抵挡住
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Let's hold off making a final decision until all the quarterly data is in.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在所有季度数据汇总出来之前，我们先暂缓做出最终决定。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 压制/抑制；保住（职位或工作）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Despite working two jobs, he struggled to hold down a stable routine.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 尽管打了两份工，他仍难以维持稳定的生活作息。

idioms.meaning: 坚守阵地；坚持立场不退让
idioms.example_en: Despite severe criticism, the minister held his ground during the debate.
idioms.example_zh: 尽管饱受批评，部长在辩论中依然寸步不让，坚守自己的立场。

idioms.meaning: 站得住脚；经得起推敲
idioms.example_en: Under closer scrutiny, their initial argument simply does not hold water.
idioms.example_zh: 经过仔细推敲，他们最初的论点根本站不住脚。

idioms.meaning: 代挑大梁；坚守岗位/代为照料
idioms.example_en: Can you hold the fort for an hour while I step out for a dentist appointment?
idioms.example_zh: 我出去看个牙医，你能帮我照看一个小时办公室吗？

collocations.example_en: The board will hold an emergency meeting tomorrow morning.
collocations.example_zh: 董事会将于明早召开紧急会议。

collocations.example_en: Voters will ultimately hold elected officials accountable for their actions.
collocations.example_zh: 选民最终会就当选官员的行为向他们问责。

collocations.example_en: Many leading scientists hold the view that climate change poses an existential threat.
collocations.example_zh: 许多顶尖科学家持有一种观点，即气候变化构成了生死存亡的威胁。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 分派；分配；成批分发
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The charity lotted out the emergency supplies among the refugees.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 慈善机构把应急物资分发给了难民。

idioms.meaning: 与…共存亡；决心与…站在一起
idioms.example_en: She decided to cast her lot with the reformist faction of the party.
idioms.example_zh: 她决定与党内的改革派共进退。

idioms.meaning: 与…休戚与共；加盟并甘苦与共
idioms.example_en: The small tech startup threw in its lot with the multinational conglomerate.
idioms.example_zh: 这家小型初创科技公司选择与跨国巨头联手，共担风险。

collocations.example_en: They drew lots to decide who would work the holiday shift.
collocations.example_zh: 他们通过抽签来决定谁在假期值班。

collocations.example_en: The villagers considered him a bad lot after the embezzlement scandal.
collocations.example_zh: 贪污丑闻之后，村民们都认为他是个道德败坏的人。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 关闭（电源）；关机；（人）放松休整
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Make sure you power down the servers before maintenance.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 维护前请确保关闭所有服务器电源。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 启动；通电开机；增强力量
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The generator takes several minutes to power up completely.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 发电机完全启动需要几分钟时间。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 硬撑过去；咬紧牙关坚持完成
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Despite a terrible headache, she powered through the presentation.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 尽管头痛得厉害，她还是咬牙坚持完成了演讲。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 全速前进；蓬勃发展；强劲推进
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The economy continues to power ahead despite global trade tensions.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 尽管面临全球贸易紧张局势，该国经济仍继续保持强劲发展势头。

idioms.meaning: 当局；掌权者；管事的高层
idioms.example_en: The decision was made by the powers that be without consulting staff.
idioms.example_zh: 这个决定是高层在未征询员工意见的情况下擅自做出的。

idioms.meaning: 幕后掌权者；幕后操纵者
idioms.example_en: Many believed the chief of staff was the real power behind the throne.
idioms.example_zh: 许多人认为幕僚长才是实际的幕后掌权者。

collocations.meaning: 驱动经济；为经济注入动力
collocations.example_en: Small and medium-sized enterprises power the domestic economy.
collocations.example_zh: 中小微企业是驱动国内经济发展的中坚力量。

collocations.example_en: The nation is investing heavily in solar power to cut carbon emissions.
collocations.example_zh: 该国正大力投资太阳能发电以减少碳排放。

collocations.example_en: A bitter power struggle erupted following the CEO's resignation.
collocations.example_zh: 首席执行官辞职后，爆发了激烈的权力斗争。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 汇报；反馈（调查或任务进展）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The scout team will report back as soon as they reach the border.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 侦察小队一旦到达边境就会立即反馈情况。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 向…汇报工作；隶属于；去…报到
phrasal_verbs.example_en: In your new role, you will report directly to the marketing director.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在新的岗位上，你将直接向市场总监汇报工作。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 报到上班；报到就职
phrasal_verbs.example_en: All newly recruited officers must report for duty at 8 AM tomorrow.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 所有新招募的警官必须在明早8点报到履职。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 签到；定期联系报平安
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Hikers are strongly advised to report in at the ranger station.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 强烈建议登山者在护林站登记报到。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 报道；对…做出专题评估/汇报
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The committee was formed to report on corporate governance reform.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 该委员会的成立旨在对企业管治改革进行调研并发布报告。

idioms.meaning: 请病假；称病不能上班
idioms.example_en: Several subway drivers reported sick, causing massive morning delays.
idioms.example_zh: 几名地铁司机请了病假，导致早高峰出现大面积延误。

idioms.meaning: 一切正常；无异常情况汇报
idioms.example_en: The night guard checked the warehouse and radioed that there was nothing to report.
idioms.example_zh: 夜班警卫巡查了仓库，并通过对讲机通报一切正常。

collocations.example_en: The merger has been widely reported in the financial press.
collocations.example_zh: 财经媒体对这桩并购案进行了广泛的报道。

collocations.example_en: The airline reported a record quarterly profit driven by summer travel.
collocations.example_zh: 在夏季旅游热潮的推动下，该航空公司公布了创纪录的季度盈利。

collocations.meaning: 报案；报告违法犯罪行为
collocations.example_en: Witnesses are urged to report the crime to the local precinct immediately.
collocations.example_zh: 呼吁目击者立即向当地分局报案。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 张贴；张榜公布；（在社媒）发布
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The exam results will be posted up on the bulletin board tomorrow.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 考试成绩将于明天张贴在公告栏上。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 寄出；投递（信件或包裹）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I posted off the completed application forms early this morning.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我今天一大早就把填好的申请表寄出去了。

idioms.meaning: 随时向某人通报最新进展
idioms.example_en: I'm leaving for the hospital now; keep me posted on the negotiations.
idioms.example_zh: 我现在得去医院，谈判有任何最新进展请随时告诉我。

idioms.meaning: 四处奔波；颠沛流离；被推来推去
idioms.example_en: During the refugee crisis, families were driven from pillar to post.
idioms.example_zh: 在难民危机期间，许多家庭颠沛流离、无处落脚。

idioms.meaning: 耳聋极了；完全听不见
idioms.example_en: You'll have to shout; my grandfather is as deaf as a post.
idioms.example_zh: 你得大声点喊，我爷爷耳朵全聋了。

collocations.meaning: 公布强劲业绩/亮眼利润
collocations.example_en: The tech giant posted solid fourth-quarter results, exceeding analyst expectations.
collocations.example_zh: 该科技巨头公布了稳健的第四季度业绩，超出了分析师的预期。

collocations.example_en: The newly appointed ambassador will take up her post next month.
collocations.example_zh: 新任命的大使将于下月正式赴任。

collocations.example_en: The suspect was released after his family posted bail.
collocations.example_zh: 家属缴纳保释金后，嫌疑人得以获释。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 忙于…；埋头于…
phrasal_verbs.example_en: She busied herself with clearing up the kitchen to avoid awkward conversations.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 她忙着收拾厨房，以避免尴尬的交谈。

idioms.meaning: 忙得团团转；忙得不可开交
idioms.example_en: He's been as busy as a bee preparing the annual gala.
idioms.example_zh: 他一直在为筹办年度盛会忙得不可开交。

idioms.meaning: 赶快动手；忙碌起来；开始干活
idioms.example_en: We've got a tight deadline, so let's get busy.
idioms.example_zh: 我们的交期很紧，快开始干活吧。

collocations.example_en: Volunteering helps retirees keep busy and socially connected.
collocations.example_zh: 志愿服务有助于退休人员充实生活并保持社交联系。

collocations.example_en: The minister managed to squeeze in a media briefing despite her busy schedule.
collocations.example_zh: 尽管日程繁忙，部长还是抽空接受了媒体简报。

collocations.meaning: 繁华喧嚣的街道/车水马龙的十字路口
collocations.example_en: Pedestrians should exercise extra caution when crossing this busy street.
collocations.example_zh: 行人穿过这条繁忙的街道时应格外小心。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （踩点）探察；预先踩盘子
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The thieves spent weeks casing out the high-end jewelry store before the robbery.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 窃贼在抢劫前花了数周时间对那家高档珠宝店踩点。

idioms.meaning: 为…提出充分理由；有力证明…的必要性
idioms.example_en: The researcher made a compelling case for increasing green energy subsidies.
idioms.example_zh: 研究员为增加绿色能源补贴提出了极具说服力的论据。

idioms.meaning: 不停唠叨某人；挑某人的刺；盯紧某人
idioms.example_en: My supervisor has been on my case all week about the overdue project.
idioms.example_zh: 这一周我的主管都在因为逾期项目的事对我紧盯不放、反复催促。

idioms.meaning: 视具体情况而定；看具体情形
idioms.example_en: Students may choose either a written exam or an essay, as the case may be.
idioms.example_zh: 学生可以选择参加笔试或撰写论文，视具体情况而定。

collocations.example_en: The flight might be delayed, but we should head to the airport in any case.
collocations.example_zh: 航班可能会延误，但无论如何我们都应该先赶往机场。

collocations.example_en: The brand's failure is a classic case of misreading consumer trends.
collocations.example_zh: 该品牌的衰败是误判消费趋势的典型案例。

collocations.example_en: The veteran defense attorney has rarely lost a high-profile case.
collocations.example_zh: 这位资深辩护律师在备受瞩目的重大案件中鲜有败绩。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 偶然遇到；偶然发现；巧遇
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Walking down the narrow alley, we happened upon a charming bookstore.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 漫步在狭窄的小巷里，我们偶遇了一家极有韵味的书店。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 碰巧（做某事）；发生在…身上
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I happened to overhear their conversation in the hallway.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我碰巧在走廊里听到了他们的谈话。

idioms.meaning: 碰巧；巧合的是；其实
idioms.example_en: As it happens, I have an extra ticket to the concert tonight.
idioms.example_zh: 巧的是，我今晚正好有一张多余的音乐会门票。

idioms.meaning: 迟早要出事的；隐患重重的（常与 disaster/accident 连用）
idioms.example_en: Ignoring those cracked foundation beams is an accident waiting to happen.
idioms.example_zh: 忽视那些开裂的地基横梁无异于埋下随时可能引爆的安全隐患。

idioms.meaning: 人有失手，马有失蹄；天有不测风云（用以宽慰意外过失）
idioms.example_en: Don't cry over the broken vase; accidents will happen.
idioms.example_zh: 别为打碎的花瓶难过了，意外总是难免的。

collocations.example_en: With such reckless driving, an accident was bound to happen.
collocations.example_zh: 开得这么野，出车祸是迟早的事。

collocations.meaning: 无论发生什么；无论如何
collocations.example_en: Whatever happens, we must stick together as a cohesive team.
collocations.example_zh: 无论发生什么，我们作为一个团队都要团结一心。

collocations.meaning: 突然发生/一夜之间产生
collocations.example_en: Success in this competitive industry rarely happens overnight.
collocations.example_zh: 在这个竞争激烈的行业中，成功绝非一朝一夕之功。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 吃亏；受损；被淘汰
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Small mom-and-pop shops often lose out to big e-commerce platforms.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 夫妻小店往往在与大型电商平台的竞争中败下阵来。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 输给；败给
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Our agency lost out to a local competitor in the final bidding round.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我们在最后一轮竞标中输给了一家本土竞争对手。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 沉溺于；沉醉于；专心致志于
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He completely lost himself in the classical piano symphony.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他完全沉浸在古典钢琴交响乐的世界里。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 数不清；记不清…的次数
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I've lost count of how many times she has revised this proposal.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我都数不清她到底修改了多少次这份提案了。

idioms.meaning: 发脾气；大发雷霆
idioms.example_en: A seasoned diplomat should never lose their temper under media scrutiny.
idioms.example_zh: 经验丰富的外交官在媒体审视下绝不应该大发雷霆。

idioms.meaning: 丢脸；丢面子；名誉扫地
idioms.example_en: The politician refused to apologize because he was afraid of losing face.
idioms.example_zh: 那位政客拒绝道歉，因为他害怕当众丢面子。

idioms.meaning: 失去阵地；退步；丧失优势
idioms.example_en: The incumbent party has lost considerable ground in recent opinion polls.
idioms.example_zh: 执政党在近期的民意调查中失去了相当多的支持率。

collocations.example_en: She adopted a balanced low-carb diet to lose weight sustainably.
collocations.example_zh: 她通过均衡的低碳饮食来科学持久地减轻体重。

collocations.example_en: Customers began to lose patience after standing in line for two hours.
collocations.example_zh: 排队两小时后，顾客们开始失去耐心。

collocations.example_en: Over the years, I gradually lost touch with most of my college classmates.
collocations.example_zh: 多年来，我逐渐与大学的大多数同学断了联系。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 发展成为；演变成
phrasal_verbs.example_en: What started as a mild argument soon developed into a full-scale legal battle.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 最初只是一场微小的口角，很快演变成了全面的法律诉讼战。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 由…发展而来；源于
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Modern aviation technology developed from rudimentary glider prototypes.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 现代航空技术是由简陋的滑翔机原型逐步演化而来的。

idioms.meaning: 逐渐喜欢上；养成对…的鉴赏力或癖好
idioms.example_en: While living in Tokyo, she quickly developed a taste for authentic matcha.
idioms.example_zh: 在东京生活期间，她很快爱上了正宗的抹茶。

collocations.example_en: The board met behind closed doors to develop a turnaround strategy.
collocations.example_zh: 董事会举行闭门会议，共同制定扭亏为盈的重振战略。

collocations.example_en: Patients usually develop flu-like symptoms within forty-eight hours of infection.
collocations.example_zh: 患者通常在感染后48小时内出现类似流感的症状。

collocations.example_en: It takes conscious effort and consistency to develop a daily reading habit.
collocations.example_zh: 养成每日阅读的习惯需要自觉的努力与持之以恒。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 以…为基础；基于；根据
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The blockbuster movie is loosely based on a true historical espionage mission.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 这部卖座大片大体上是根据真实的谍战历史任务改编的。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 以…为基地运作；常驻于某地办公
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The freelance foreign correspondent is currently based out of Cairo.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 这位自由派特派记者目前常驻开罗开展报道。

idioms.meaning: （与某人）碰头沟通；简短联系以同步信息
idioms.example_en: I'll touch base with you after my client meeting on Friday.
idioms.example_zh: 周五见完客户后，我会和你简要碰一下情况。

idioms.meaning: 考虑周全；面面俱到；做好万全准备
idioms.example_en: The legal contract was meticulously drafted to cover all the bases.
idioms.example_zh: 这份法律合同起草得极其缜密，做到了防患于未然、面面俱到。

idioms.meaning: 大错特错；不着边际；离谱
idioms.example_en: His estimation of our annual revenue was completely off base.
idioms.example_zh: 他对我们年收入的估算完全离谱、大错特错。

collocations.example_en: The pharmaceutical enterprise is based in Switzerland with branches worldwide.
collocations.example_zh: 该制药企业的总部位于瑞士，分支机构遍布全球。

collocations.example_en: We need a broadly based coalition to push these landmark environmental reforms forward.
collocations.example_zh: 我们需要建立一个基础广泛的联盟来推动这些里程碑式的环保改革。

collocations.example_en: The software company has expanded its loyal customer base through top-tier service.
collocations.example_zh: 该软件公司通过顶级服务扩大了其忠实客户群。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 拒绝（提议、申请等）；调低（音量、温度等）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: She turned down the job offer because it required too much travel.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 她拒绝了这份工作邀约，因为出差太频繁。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 结果是；证明是；出席；制造
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The event turned out to be much more successful than we expected.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 事实证明，这次活动比我们预期的要成功得多。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 突然出现；被找到；调大（音量、热量等）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Don't worry, your keys will turn up sooner or later.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 别担心，你的钥匙迟早会出现的。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 变成；转变为
phrasal_verbs.example_en: A minor misunderstanding soon turned into a heated argument.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 一个小小的误会很快演变成了一场激烈的争吵。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （使）好转；扭亏为盈；转身
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The new CEO managed to turn the struggling company around in just two years.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 新任首席执行官在短短两年内就使这家陷入困境的公司扭亏为盈。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 翻转；移交（权力、控制权）；营业额达到
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He will turn over the management of the firm to his daughter.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他将把公司的管理权移交给他的女儿。

idioms.meaning: 视而不见；假装没看见
idioms.example_en: The authorities chose to turn a blind eye to the minor infractions.
idioms.example_zh: 有关部门对这些轻微的违规行为采取了视而不见的态度。

idioms.meaning: 改过自新；翻开人生新的一页
idioms.example_en: Since getting out of prison, he has promised to turn over a new leaf.
idioms.example_zh: 出狱后，他承诺要痛改前非，重新做人。

idioms.meaning: 引人注目；引来众人艳羡的目光
idioms.example_en: Her striking red dress really turned heads at the party.
idioms.example_zh: 她在派对上穿的那件引人注目的红裙子吸引了所有人的目光。

collocations.example_en: After months of economic hardship, the country has finally turned a corner.
collocations.example_zh: 在经历了数月的经济困难后，该国经济终于迎来了转机。

collocations.example_en: We must now turn our attention to the next phase of the project.
collocations.example_zh: 我们现在必须把注意力转向项目的下一阶段。

collocations.example_en: He turned pale when he heard the unexpected news.
collocations.example_zh: 听到这个意外的消息，他脸色变得煞白。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （商店、工厂等）永久倒闭；停业
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Many small independent shops had to close down during the recession.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 经济衰退期间，许多独立小店不得不关门停业。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 包围；逼近；（白天）渐短
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Dense fog started to close in as evening approached.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 黄昏临近时，浓雾开始笼罩四周。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 封锁（道路、区域）；隔绝
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Police closed off the surrounding streets to investigate the crime scene.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 警方封锁了周围街道以勘查犯罪现场。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 结束；清仓处理
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The team needs one more win to close out the series.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 这支球队还需要一场胜利来彻底终结这轮系列赛。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （伤口）愈合；暂时停业；靠近
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The shopkeeper usually closes up around eight o'clock.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 店主通常在八点左右打烊。

idioms.meaning: 紧密团结；一致对外
idioms.example_en: The cabinet closed ranks behind the prime minister despite intense media scrutiny.
idioms.example_zh: 尽管媒体严厉监督，内阁成员依然紧密团结在首相周围。

idioms.meaning: 结束对...的调查；对...盖棺定论
idioms.example_en: Investigators decided to close the book on the cold case due to lack of evidence.
idioms.example_zh: 由于缺乏证据，调查人员决定就此终结这桩悬案。

collocations.example_en: The initiative aims to close the gap between rural and urban education.
collocations.example_zh: 该倡议旨在缩小城乡教育之间的差距。

collocations.example_en: It took weeks of negotiation to close the multimillion-dollar deal.
collocations.example_zh: 经过数周的谈判才终于敲定了这笔价值数百万美元的交易。

collocations.example_en: You will need to visit the local branch in person to close the account.
collocations.example_zh: 你需要亲自去当地网点注销该账户。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 合情合理；说得通；把...加起来
phrasal_verbs.example_en: His explanation just doesn't add up; something feels wrong.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他的解释根本说不通，感觉有些蹊跷。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 总计达到；等同于；意味着
phrasal_verbs.example_en: All these small expenses add up to a substantial amount over the year.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 所有这些零碎开销一年累积起来也是一笔不小的数目。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 增加；增添（负担、困难、乐趣等）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The unexpected travel delay only added to our frustration.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 意外的行程延误只是徒增了我们的沮丧。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 附加；额外增加（费用、建筑等）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: They decided to add on a sunroom at the back of the house.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他们决定在房屋后部扩建一间日光浴室。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 包含进；把...算进去
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Remember to add in the cost of shipping when calculating total expenses.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 计算总费用时别忘了把运费算进去。

idioms.meaning: 火上浇油；激化矛盾
idioms.example_en: His sarcastic remarks only added fuel to the fire during the debate.
idioms.example_zh: 他在辩论中的讽刺言论只会火上浇油。

idioms.meaning: 雪上加霜；在受伤害之后又受侮辱
idioms.example_en: To add insult to injury, we were charged an extra cancellation fee after the flight was canceled.
idioms.example_zh: 雪上加霜的是，航班取消后他们居然还向我们收取了额外的退票手续费。

collocations.example_en: Our consulting services are designed to add measurable value to your business.
collocations.example_zh: 我们的咨询服务旨在为您的企业创造可衡量的价值。

collocations.meaning: 使...更有分量；增加可信度
collocations.example_en: Recent empirical studies add weight to the proposed theory.
collocations.example_zh: 近期的实证研究增强了这一理论的可信度。

collocations.example_en: Fresh herbs add a touch of flavor and elegance to the dish.
collocations.example_zh: 新鲜香草为这道菜增添了一丝风味与雅致。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 顺道拜访；顺便走访
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Feel free to stop by my office if you have any questions.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 如果你有任何问题，随时可以顺道来我办公室。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （飞行途中）中途停留
phrasal_verbs.example_en: We stopped over in Singapore for two days on our flight to Sydney.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我们在飞往悉尼的途中在新加坡停留了两天。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （旅途中）中途短暂停留
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Let's stop off at the grocery store on our way home.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我们在回家路上顺便在杂货店停一下吧。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 决定不做某事；止步于...之前
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The report criticized the policy heavily but stopped short of recommending its repeal.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 该报告严厉批评了该政策，但并未建议将其废除。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 熬夜；塞住；堵塞
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The plumber used a sealant to stop up the leaking pipe.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 水管工用密封剂堵住了漏水的管道。

idioms.meaning: 不择手段；不达目的誓不罢休
idioms.example_en: He is an ambitious politician who will stop at nothing to gain power.
idioms.example_zh: 他是一个野心勃勃的政客，为了夺取权力会不择手段。

idioms.meaning: 突然愣住；猛然停下脚步
idioms.example_en: She stopped dead in her tracks when she heard the sudden crash.
idioms.example_zh: 听到突然的巨响，她猛然停下了脚步。

collocations.example_en: Apply direct pressure to the wound to stop the bleeding immediately.
collocations.example_zh: 立即直接按压伤口以止血。

collocations.meaning: 阻断交通；（因美貌或奇观）引得万人空巷
collocations.example_en: The marathon route will stop traffic across downtown on Sunday.
collocations.example_zh: 马拉松比赛路线将在周日阻断市中心的交通。

collocations.example_en: The sharp warning whistle stopped the intruders in their tracks.
collocations.example_zh: 刺耳的警报哨声让入侵者骤然停住了脚步。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 腾出（时间、资金、存储空间等）；释放
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Deleting unused apps helped free up valuable storage on my phone.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 删除不常用的应用程序帮我释放了手机上的宝贵存储空间。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 使免受；使从...中解脱出来
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The treatment freed the patient from chronic joint pain.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 这种疗法使患者摆脱了长期的关节疼痛。

idioms.meaning: 放空心灵；消除杂念
idioms.example_en: Meditation can help you free your mind from daily anxiety.
idioms.example_zh: 冥想有助于你放空心灵，摆脱日常的焦虑。

collocations.example_en: Special forces successfully freed the hostages without any casualties.
collocations.example_zh: 特种部队成功解救了人质，且无人员伤亡。

collocations.example_en: Selling non-core assets helped free capital for core business expansion.
collocations.example_zh: 出售非核心资产有助于释放资金以扩大核心业务。

collocations.meaning: 挣脱；使自己摆脱（束缚或偏见）
collocations.example_en: It takes courage to free oneself from outdated cultural traditions.
collocations.example_zh: 摆脱过时的文化传统需要巨大的勇气。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 走向；前往；招致（不良后果）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: If we don't reduce spending, we are heading for a financial crisis.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 如果我们不削减开支，我们就是在自招财务危机。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 阻止；拦截；防范（危机、危险等）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Diplomats are working around the clock to head off a potential war.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 外交官们正夜以继日地工作，以防范潜在的战争风险。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 主管；领导；率领（团队、部门等）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: She was chosen to head up the newly created research division.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 她被选拔去领导新设立的研究部门。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 出发；离开
phrasal_verbs.example_en: We should pack our bags and head out before the rush hour begins.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我们应该收拾行李，在早高峰开始前出发。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 动身返回
phrasal_verbs.example_en: It's getting late, so we decided to head back to our hotel.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 天色已晚，我们决定动身返回酒店。

idioms.meaning: 走向正轨；朝着正确的方向发展
idioms.example_en: Although slow, the peace talks are heading in the right direction.
idioms.example_zh: 虽然进展缓慢，但和平谈判正在朝着正确的方向发展。

idioms.meaning: 注定失败；自取灭亡
idioms.example_en: Ignoring safety regulations means the project is heading for disaster.
idioms.example_zh: 无视安全法规意味着该项目注定要遭遇灾难。

collocations.meaning: 主持委员会；担任委员会主席
collocations.example_en: The senior senator was appointed to head the oversight committee.
collocations.example_zh: 这位资深参议员被任命为主持监督委员会。

collocations.example_en: Climate change heads the list of global concerns this year.
collocations.example_zh: 气候变化位居今年全球关注问题的榜首。

collocations.meaning: 向南走；（比喻经济、指标）恶化、下跌
collocations.example_en: Company profits began to head south in the second quarter.
collocations.example_zh: 公司利润在第二季度开始走下坡路。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 交出；转交（权力、职责、财物）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The outgoing governor handed over control to his elected successor.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 即将卸任的州长将管理权移交给了他的民选继任者。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 呈递；交上（作业、辞呈等）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Students must hand in their essays by Friday afternoon.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 学生必须在周五下午前交上论文。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 分发；施舍；给予（建议或批评）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Volunteers handed out warm blankets and food to the homeless.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 志愿者向无家可归者分发保暖毯子和食物。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 传给（后代）；宣布（判决、裁定）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The heirloom ring was handed down through several generations.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 这枚传家宝戒指世代相传了好几辈。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 归还；还给原主
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The teacher graded the exams and handed them back to the class.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 老师批改完试卷后将其发还给了全班同学。

idioms.meaning: 不得不佩服某人；赞扬某人
idioms.example_en: You have to hand it to him; he organized the entire conference all by himself.
idioms.example_zh: 你不得不佩服他，他独自一人筹办了整场大型会议。

idioms.phrase: hand something on a silver platter
idioms.meaning: 拱手奉上；不费吹灰之力给予某人
idioms.example_en: Don't expect life to hand you success on a silver platter; work for it.
idioms.example_zh: 别指望生活会把成功拱手送给你，凡事都要靠自己努力。

collocations.example_en: Frustrated with the leadership, the marketing director handed in his resignation.
collocations.example_zh: 由于对领导层感到失望，市场总监递交了辞呈。

collocations.example_en: The jury is expected to hand down a verdict tomorrow morning.
collocations.example_zh: 预计陪审团将在明天上午作出裁决。

collocations.meaning: 击败某人；让某人品尝败局
collocations.example_en: The underdog team handed the reigning champions a shocking defeat.
collocations.example_zh: 这支不被看好的队伍出人意料地击溃了卫冕冠军。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 信仰；深信...的存在；赞成；对...有信心
phrasal_verbs.example_en: A good teacher believes in her students' potential even when they doubt themselves.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 优秀的老师即使在学生自我怀疑时，依然坚信他们的潜力。

idioms.meaning: 信不信由你
idioms.example_en: Believe it or not, they finished building the bridge in just six months.
idioms.example_zh: 信不信由你，他们仅用了六个月就建成了这座桥。

idioms.meaning: 眼见为实；百闻不如一见
idioms.example_en: I couldn't imagine how fast the new train was until I rode it—seeing is believing.
idioms.example_zh: 坐上新高铁之前我想象不出它有多快——真是百闻不如一见。

idioms.meaning: 假装；虚构
idioms.example_en: The children loved to make believe they were astronauts exploring Mars.
idioms.example_zh: 孩子们喜欢假装自己是在火星探索的宇航员。

collocations.example_en: We firmly believe that education is the most powerful tool to end poverty.
collocations.example_zh: 我们坚信，教育是终结贫困最有力的工具。

collocations.example_en: It is hard to believe that ten years have passed since graduation.
collocations.example_zh: 令人难以置信的是，毕业至今竟然已经过去十年了。

collocations.meaning: 持有不同看法；认为并非如此
collocations.example_en: Though evidence pointed to fraud, the manager continued to believe otherwise.
collocations.example_zh: 尽管证据指向欺诈，该经理依然坚信事实并非如此。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 收到...的来信（或电话、消息）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I haven't heard from my college roommate in nearly a year.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我已经将近一年没收到我大学室友的音讯了。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 听说过；获悉（某人或某事物的存在）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I've never heard of that author, but her book has rave reviews.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我从没听说过那位作家，但她的书却广受好评。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 听某人把话说完
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Please hear me out before jumping to conclusions.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 请听我把话说完，先别急着下结论。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 得知；听到有关...的消息
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Did you hear about the merger announced in today's paper?
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 你听说今天报纸上公布的并购消息了吗？

idioms.meaning: 绝不同意；绝不赞成
idioms.example_en: I offered to pay for dinner, but she wouldn't hear of it.
idioms.example_zh: 我提出请客吃晚饭，但她坚决不同意。

idioms.meaning: 静得连一根针掉在地上都听得见
idioms.example_en: The room went so silent you could hear a pin drop.
idioms.example_zh: 房间里顿时安静得连一根针掉在地上都能听见。

collocations.example_en: I heard a rumor that the branch office might close next month.
collocations.example_zh: 我听到传闻说分公司可能下个月就要关闭了。

collocations.example_en: The Supreme Court agreed to hear the antitrust case next term.
collocations.example_zh: 最高法院同意在下个审期审理这桩反垄断诉讼案。

collocations.example_en: The local priest sits to hear confessions every Saturday afternoon.
collocations.example_zh: 当地神父每周六下午都会坐下来听取信徒的告解。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 预订一空；预约满额（常用于被动 be booked up）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Hotels in the coastal town are completely booked up for the summer.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 该海滨小镇的酒店在夏季已被彻底预订一空。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 办理入住/签到登记；预约登记
phrasal_verbs.example_en: We arrived at the resort and booked in at the reception desk.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我们到达度假村后在前台办理了入住登记手续。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 预订（某酒店、活动等）并入住
phrasal_verbs.example_en: They booked into a boutique hotel near the cathedral.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他们在教堂附近预订并入住了一家精品酒店。

idioms.meaning: 日程排得满满当当；预订一空
idioms.example_en: The consultant is booked solid with client meetings for the next two weeks.
idioms.example_zh: 这位顾问未来两周的客户会议日程已经排得满满当当。

collocations.example_en: It is advisable to book your flight well in advance to get cheaper fares.
collocations.example_zh: 建议提早预订机票，以获得更优惠的票价。

collocations.example_en: I booked a table for four at the Italian restaurant for eight o'clock.
collocations.example_zh: 我在那家意大利餐厅预订了晚上八点四人位的餐桌。

collocations.example_en: The committee needs to book a venue large enough for three hundred attendees.
collocations.example_zh: 委员会需要预定一个足以容纳三百名与会者的大场地。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 提前计划；未雨绸缪
phrasal_verbs.example_en: It is always wise to plan ahead when traveling abroad during peak season.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 旺季出国旅行时，提前做好规划总是明智的。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 打算做某事；把……纳入计划
phrasal_verbs.example_en: We hadn't planned on staying overnight, but the storm forced us to.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我们原本没打算过夜，但暴风雨迫使我们留了下来。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 周密安排；精心策划
phrasal_verbs.example_en: She sat down to plan out her career goals for the next five years.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 她坐下来仔细规划了自己未来五年的职业目标。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 为……做准备；把……考虑在内
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Urban developers must plan for population growth over the coming decades.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 城市规划人员必须把未来几十年的生人口增长考虑在内。

idioms.meaning: 按原计划进行；进展顺利
idioms.example_en: Fortunately, the product launch went entirely according to plan.
idioms.example_zh: 庆幸的是，新产品发布会完全是按计划顺利推进的。

idioms.meaning: （无论多么）周密完美的计划
idioms.example_en: Even the best-laid plans can go awry when unexpected crises strike.
idioms.example_zh: 突发危机降临时，再周密的计划也可能会落空。

collocations.example_en: Let's make a plan before we rush into any decisions.
collocations.example_zh: 在我们仓促做决定之前，先制定个计划吧。

collocations.example_en: The team drafted an action plan to address customer churn.
collocations.example_zh: 团队草拟了一份旨在解决客户流失的行动方案。

collocations.example_en: Always have a backup plan in case negotiations fall through.
collocations.example_zh: 一定要备有后手，以防谈判破裂。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 叫外卖；点外卖到家
phrasal_verbs.example_en: We were too tired to cook, so we decided to order in.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我们累得不想做饭，于是决定叫外卖。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 对某人指手画脚；呼来喝去
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He hates the way his new manager orders everyone around.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他非常反感新经理对大家颐指气使的样子。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 命令……离开；叫外卖送来
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The referee ordered the unruly player out of the game.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 裁判责令那名不守规矩的球员离场。

idioms.meaning: 难以完成的苛刻任务；过高的要求
idioms.example_en: Doubling sales in one quarter is a tall order, but we will try.
idioms.example_zh: 在一个季度内将销售额翻倍是个极难的任务，但我们会尽力而为。

idioms.meaning: 发生故障；行为不得体/不合程序
idioms.example_en: The elevator is temporarily out of order for routine maintenance.
idioms.example_zh: 电梯因例行检修暂时暂停使用。

idioms.meaning: 迅速；立刻
idioms.example_en: The issue was resolved in short order once the experts arrived.
idioms.example_zh: 专家一赶到，问题很快就迎刃而解了。

collocations.example_en: You can place an order directly through our official app.
collocations.example_zh: 你可以直接通过我们的官方应用程序下单。

collocations.example_en: Police were deployed to restore order after the riots erupted.
collocations.example_zh: 骚乱发生后，警方被调遣去恢复社会秩序。

collocations.example_en: The new supercomputer is an order of magnitude faster than its predecessor.
collocations.example_zh: 这台新超级计算机比上一代快了一个数量级。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 将……斩尽杀绝；扼杀；在虚构作品中写死（角色）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Pesticides not only kill pests but can also kill off beneficial insects.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 杀虫剂不仅消灭害虫，还会把有益昆虫斩尽杀绝。

idioms.meaning: 打发时间；消磨时光
idioms.example_en: I browsed magazines in the lounge to kill time before boarding.
idioms.example_zh: 登机前，我在休息室翻看杂志来打发时间。

idioms.phrase: kill two birds with one stone
idioms.meaning: 一举两得；一石二鸟
idioms.example_en: Cycling to work kills two birds with one stone: saving money and staying fit.
idioms.example_zh: 骑自行车上班一举两得：既能省钱，又能强身健体。

idioms.meaning: 大煞风景；扫兴
idioms.example_en: His cynical remarks completely killed the mood at the party.
idioms.example_zh: 他那些冷嘲热讽的话彻底破坏了聚会的气氛。

collocations.example_en: The doctor prescribed strong painkillers to kill the post-surgery pain.
collocations.example_zh: 医生开了强效止痛药来缓解术后的疼痛。

collocations.example_en: He pulled over to the curb and killed the engine.
collocations.example_zh: 他把车靠边停稳，随后关掉了引擎。

collocations.meaning: 否决（提案）；扼杀（想法/法案）
collocations.example_en: Budget constraints ultimately killed the ambitious expansion project.
collocations.example_zh: 预算吃紧最终让那个宏大的扩张方案胎死腹中。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 理解并产生共鸣；涉及/与……有关
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Many young professionals find it easy to relate to the protagonist's struggles.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 许多职场新人觉得很容易对主角的挣扎产生共鸣。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 追溯到；与……再次联系起来
phrasal_verbs.example_en: All the symptoms described here relate back to chronic sleep deprivation.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 这里所描述的所有症状都可以追溯到长期的睡眠不足。

collocations.example_en: Language skills and cognitive development are closely related in early childhood.
collocations.example_zh: 在幼儿早期，语言能力与认知发展息息相关。

collocations.example_en: The evidence presented in court relates directly to the suspect's alibi.
collocations.example_zh: 法庭上出示的证据直接关系到嫌疑人的不在场证明。

collocations.example_en: The survivor took the stage to relate his terrifying ordeal during the earthquake.
collocations.example_zh: 幸存者走上讲台，讲述了他在地震中那段可怕的遭遇。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 排队；安排/组织妥当；把……排列成行
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The recruiter has lined up several promising candidates for interview.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 招聘人员已经安排好了几位有潜力的候选人参加面试。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 给……加衬里；用……沿途铺衬
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Line the baking tray with parchment paper before pouring the batter.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 倒入面糊前，先在烤盘上垫一层烘焙纸。

idioms.meaning: 服从命令；听从指挥；按规矩办事
idioms.example_en: Employees who refuse to toe the line risk losing their positions.
idioms.example_zh: 拒绝守规矩的员工可能会面临丢掉工作的风险。

idioms.meaning: 领会言外之意；读出潜台词
idioms.example_en: If you read between the lines, the statement suggests imminent job cuts.
idioms.example_zh: 如果仔细体会言外之意，这份声明暗示着即将裁员。

idioms.meaning: 中饱私囊；借机敛财
idioms.example_en: Corrupt officials used the infrastructure fund to line their own pockets.
idioms.example_zh: 腐败官员利用基建资金来大肆中饱私囊。

collocations.meaning: 盈亏底线；核心问题/最终底线
collocations.example_en: The bottom line is that the company must cut operational costs immediately.
collocations.example_zh: 最关键的问题是，公司必须立即削减运营成本。

collocations.meaning: 沿街排列；挤满街道两旁
collocations.example_en: Tens of thousands lined the streets to welcome the returning champions.
collocations.example_zh: 数以万计的人挤满街头两旁，夹道欢迎凯旋的冠军们。

collocations.example_en: The dissenting members gradually fell into line behind the new leadership.
collocations.example_zh: 持异议的成员逐渐服从并拥护新领导班子。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 抚养；提出（议题）；呕吐
phrasal_verbs.example_en: She decided to bring up the budget deficit during the executive meeting.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 她决定在高管会议上提出预算赤字的问题。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 引起；导致；带来（改变）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Technological breakthroughs have brought about major shifts in retail.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 技术突破给零售业带来了翻天覆地的转变。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 使显现/展现（特质）；推出（新产品）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The coach has a remarkable ability to bring out the best in his athletes.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 这位教练有一种非凡的能力，能把运动员最优秀的一面激发出来。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 赚得；引进（人才/法规）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The tourism initiative is expected to bring in billions of dollars.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 这项旅游发展举措预计将带来数十亿美元的收入。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 使倒台/推翻；降低（价格/利率）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Central banks raised rates aggressively to bring down inflation.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 多国央行激进加息以抑制并拉低通胀。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 将……提前；提出（建议/计划）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Due to the impending storm, they brought forward the launch date.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 由于风暴即将来临，他们把发射日期提前了。

idioms.meaning: 揭露；揭发；使……曝光
idioms.example_en: The investigative reporter helped bring widespread corporate fraud to light.
idioms.example_zh: 这名调查记者协助揭露了这家企业内部大范围的欺诈行为。

idioms.meaning: 赚钱养家；获得成功
idioms.example_en: Both parents work full-time to bring home the bacon in today's economy.
idioms.example_zh: 在当下的经济环境下，夫妻双方都在全职工作以赚钱养家。

idioms.meaning: 使屈服；重创/使崩溃
idioms.example_en: Prolonged droughts can bring local agricultural economies to their knees.
idioms.example_zh: 长期的干旱足以给当地的农业经济带来毁灭性打击。

collocations.example_en: A formal treaty finally brought years of hostility to an end.
collocations.example_zh: 一项正式条约终于宣告了多年敌对状态的结束。

collocations.example_en: The authorities vowed that the perpetrators would be brought to justice.
collocations.example_zh: 有关部门誓言必将犯罪分子绳之以法。

collocations.example_en: The audit brought the integrity of the company's financial reports into question.
collocations.example_zh: 审计结果让人们对该公司的财务报表真实性产生了严重怀疑。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 期望；寄望于
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Negotiators are still hoping for a diplomatic breakthrough before midnight.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 谈判代表们仍期望能在午夜前取得外交突破。

idioms.meaning: 抱有一线渺茫的希望；存侥幸心理
idioms.example_en: The family hoped against hope that the missing hikers were still alive.
idioms.example_zh: 家属们抱着一线微弱的希望，期盼失踪的徒步者依然活着。

idioms.meaning: 抱最好的打算；寄予厚望
idioms.example_en: We must prepare for the worst while continuing to hope for the best.
idioms.example_zh: 我们要作最坏的准备，同时抱最好的希望。

idioms.meaning: 把全部希望寄托在……上
idioms.example_en: The laboratory pinned all its hopes on the new trial vaccine.
idioms.example_zh: 实验室把所有的希望都寄托在了这款新型试验疫苗上。

collocations.example_en: Rescuers refused to give up hope despite freezing weather conditions.
collocations.example_zh: 尽管天气极度严寒，搜救人员依然不肯放弃希望。

collocations.example_en: The foreign minister expressed hope for enduring peace in the region.
collocations.example_zh: 外长对该地区实现持久和平表达了殷切期望。

collocations.meaning: 抱有希望；保留一丝指望
collocations.example_en: Economists still hold out hope that a recession can be avoided.
collocations.example_zh: 经济学家们仍然抱有一丝希望，认为经济衰退是可以避免的。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 供养；提供生活所需；（法律/计划中）防备/预先规定
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He worked two jobs to provide for his growing family.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他打两份工来供养他那个不断添丁的家庭。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 预防；对……做好防备
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Insurance policies are designed to provide against catastrophic loss.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 保险条款旨在防范灾难性损失的发生。

collocations.example_en: The Red Cross quickly mobilized to provide humanitarian assistance to refugees.
collocations.example_zh: 红十字会迅速行动起来，向难民提供人道主义援助。

collocations.example_en: Mentors provide constructive feedback on students' research proposals.
collocations.example_zh: 导师们会对学生的研究开题报告提供建设性的反馈意见。

collocations.example_en: The exchange program provides an invaluable opportunity to broaden one's horizon.
collocations.example_zh: 这项交换生项目为拓宽眼界提供了不可多得的良机。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 分包；把（零碎工作）外包出去
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The agency decided to job out the website design to freelance developers.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 该机构决定把网站设计工作外包给自由职业开发者。

idioms.meaning: 奏效；管用；达到预期效果
idioms.example_en: A simple reboot will often do the job when the software glitches.
idioms.example_zh: 当软件出现小毛病时，简单重启一下通常就能解决问题。

idioms.meaning: 在工作中；在上班执勤时
idioms.example_en: Interns acquire critical technical skills on the job.
idioms.example_zh: 实习生们是在实际工作中掌握关键技术技能的。

idioms.phrase: make the best of a bad job
idioms.meaning: 在逆境中尽力而为；随遇而安
idioms.example_en: Flight delayed by six hours, we tried to make the best of a bad job by touring the airport.
idioms.example_zh: 航班延误了六个小时，我们逛了逛机场，尽量在不如意的情况下找点乐子。

collocations.example_en: We need reliable leaders who can step up and get the job done under pressure.
collocations.example_zh: 我们需要能在高压下挺身而出并把事情办妥的靠谱领导者。

collocations.example_en: Competition in the technology job market has intensified over recent years.
collocations.example_zh: 近年来科技行业的就业市场竞争愈发激烈。

collocations.example_en: Autonomy and fair compensation are key drivers of employee job satisfaction.
collocations.example_zh: 自主权和公平的薪酬是提升员工工作满意度的核心因素。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （机器等）出毛病；（人）调皮捣蛋/不听话；（旧伤）复发
phrasal_verbs.example_en: My back injury started to act up again after lifting those heavy boxes.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 搬完那些沉重的箱子后，我的腰部旧疾又开始复发了。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 把……表演出来；以越轨行为发泄情绪
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Troubled teenagers often act out when they feel misunderstood.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 身处困境的青少年在感到不被理解时，往往会通过叛逆行为来发泄情绪。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 奉行；根据……采取行动；对……起作用
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Police acted promptly on the anonymous tip and raided the warehouse.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 警方根据匿名线索迅速采取行动，突击搜查了那座仓库。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 充当；担任；起……的作用
phrasal_verbs.example_en: A senior colleague offered to act as a mentor for the newcomers.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 一位资深同事主动提出担任新员工的导师。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 代理；代表（行使职责）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The attorney is authorized to act for his client in all commercial transactions.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 该律师已获授权在所有商业交易中代表其当事人行事。

idioms.meaning: 振作起来；整顿好自己；组织得井井有条
idioms.example_en: You need to get your act together if you want to pass the entrance exams.
idioms.example_zh: 如果你想通过入学考试，就必须打起精神、好好规整一番。

idioms.meaning: 改邪归正；端正行为举止
idioms.example_en: The corporation was warned to clean up its environmental act or face sanctions.
idioms.example_zh: 该企业收到警告，必须端正其环保行为，否则将面临制裁。

idioms.meaning: 当场被抓；人赃俱获
idioms.example_en: The embezzler was caught in the act while transferring illicit funds.
idioms.example_zh: 那名侵吞公款者在转移非法资金时被抓了个现行。

collocations.example_en: The government must act decisively to stabilize fluctuating food prices.
collocations.example_zh: 政府必须采取果断行动以稳定波动的食品价格。

collocations.meaning: 出于善意行事；诚实履约
collocations.example_en: Both contracting parties are legally presumed to have acted in good faith.
collocations.example_zh: 法律上推定合同双方都是出于善意履约的。

collocations.example_en: Corporations have an obligation to act responsibly toward the environment.
collocations.example_zh: 企业有义务对环境采取负责任的行动。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 导致；造成…的结果
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The sudden downpour resulted in severe traffic congestion across the city.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 突如其来的暴雨导致全城交通严重拥堵。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 由…引起；起因于
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Many illnesses result directly from chronic stress and lack of sleep.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 许多疾病都是由长期压力和睡眠不足直接引起的。

idioms.meaning: 结果；因此
idioms.example_en: He injured his knee and, as a result, had to withdraw from the marathon.
idioms.example_zh: 他膝盖受伤，因此不得不退出马拉松比赛。

collocations.example_en: Months of intense negotiations ultimately resulted in success.
collocations.example_zh: 数月紧张的谈判最终以成功告终。

collocations.example_en: The new marketing strategy failed to produce the desired result.
collocations.example_zh: 新的营销策略未能取得预期的成效。

idioms.meaning: 看来似乎如此；貌似如此（用于委婉陈述）
idioms.example_en: It would seem that the system was hacked several days ago.
idioms.example_zh: 该系统似乎在几天前就已被黑客入侵。

idioms.phrase: seem like a good idea at the time
idioms.meaning: 当时看来是个好主意（暗示事后证明是个错误）
idioms.example_en: Investing all our savings in that start-up seemed like a good idea at the time.
idioms.example_zh: 当时把我们所有的积蓄投资在那家初创公司看来是个好主意。

collocations.meaning: 看似不太可能/绝不可能
collocations.example_en: It seems unlikely that mortgage rates will drop significantly this year.
collocations.example_zh: 今年房贷利率大幅下降看似不太可能。

collocations.example_en: Under the current circumstances, their compromise proposal seems reasonable.
collocations.example_zh: 在目前情况下，他们的折中方案显得合情合理。

collocations.example_en: There seems to be a misunderstanding regarding the delivery date.
collocations.example_zh: 关于交货日期似乎存在误解。

collocations.example_en: The government's economic stimulus is finally starting to produce results.
collocations.example_zh: 政府的经济刺激措施终于开始见效了。

collocations.example_en: The prosecution failed to produce sufficient evidence to convict the defendant.
collocations.example_zh: 控方未能出示充分的证据来定罪被告。

collocations.example_en: The newly introduced regulations produced an immediate effect on market stability.
collocations.example_zh: 新出台的法规对市场稳定起到了立竿见影的效果。

idioms.meaning: 把自己的意思表达清楚；让人理解自己
idioms.example_en: His English was limited, but he managed to make himself understood.
idioms.example_zh: 他的英语水平有限，但还是把自己的意思表达清楚了。

idioms.meaning: 暗示某人；使某人确信/相信
idioms.example_en: I was given to understand that the job offer was already guaranteed.
idioms.example_zh: 当时有人暗示我，这个录用名额已经是板上钉钉了。

collocations.example_en: Do you fully understand the consequences of signing this contract?
collocations.example_zh: 你充分理解签署这份合同的后果吗？

collocations.example_en: The young diplomat clearly understood the gravity of the diplomatic crisis.
collocations.example_zh: 这位年轻的外交官清楚地认识到了这场外交危机的严重性。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 稀释；削弱，淡化（观点、政策等）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The original climate bill was heavily watered down before passing the senate.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 最初的气候法案在参议院通过前被大幅削弱淡化了。

idioms.meaning: （论据、解释等）站得住脚，经得起推敲
idioms.example_en: His alibi simply does not hold water under close scrutiny.
idioms.example_zh: 他的不在场证明经不起仔细推敲，根本站不住脚。

idioms.meaning: 令人垂涎三尺；引人嘴馋
idioms.example_en: The aroma of roasted garlic and rosemary made my mouth water.
idioms.example_zh: 烤大蒜和迷迭香的香气让我垂涎三尺。

idioms.meaning: 过去的陈年旧事；无法挽回的既成事实
idioms.example_en: We had our differences in the past, but that is all water under the bridge now.
idioms.example_zh: 我们过去确实有些分歧，但现在那都已经是陈年旧事了。

collocations.example_en: Chopping raw onions always makes my eyes water.
collocations.example_zh: 切生洋葱总是让我眼泪直流。

collocations.example_en: Remember to water the plants while I am away on vacation.
collocations.example_zh: 我休假外出期间记得给植物浇水。

idioms.meaning: 用言语表达
idioms.example_en: She found it difficult to put her intense grief into words.
idioms.example_zh: 她觉得很难用言语来表达自己内心的深切悲痛。

idioms.meaning: 相信某人的话；信以为真
idioms.example_en: He promised to return the loan by Friday, and I took him at his word.
idioms.example_zh: 他答应周五还钱，我就信了他的话。

collocations.meaning: 措辞谨慎的；字斟句酌的
collocations.example_en: The board issued a carefully worded statement regarding the CEO's departure.
collocations.example_zh: 董事会就首席执行官的离职发表了一份措辞谨慎的声明。

collocations.meaning: 撰写/起草一封信件或声明
collocations.example_en: The complaint letter was strongly worded to demand immediate action.
collocations.example_zh: 这封投诉信措辞强硬，要求立即采取行动。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 与…交战；同…搏斗或激烈对抗
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The rebel factions continued to war with each other over natural resources.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 叛乱各派继续为了争夺自然资源而相互交战。

idioms.meaning: 与…处于交战/冲突状态；内心挣扎对抗
idioms.example_en: He felt at war with himself over whether to accept the lucrative offer.
idioms.example_zh: 关于是否接受那份待遇优厚的工作，他内心陷入了极度的交战之中。

idioms.meaning: 向…宣战；对…发动进攻或斗争
idioms.example_en: The medical organization launched a global campaign to wage war on diabetes.
idioms.example_zh: 该医疗组织发起了一场全球运动，向糖尿病宣战。

collocations.example_en: Diplomats urged the warring factions to agree to an immediate ceasefire.
collocations.example_zh: 外交官敦促交战各派立即同意停火。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 以…开始；起初
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The meeting began with a brief presentation from the research team.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 会议以研究团队的一场简短汇报开场。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 起初作为；最初的形式是
phrasal_verbs.example_en: What began as a personal blog soon evolved into a multimillion-dollar media company.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 起初只是个个人博客，很快就演变成了一家价值数百万美元的媒体公司。

idioms.meaning: 首先；起初；本来
idioms.example_en: We shouldn't have hired him in the first place—to begin with, he lacked relevant experience.
idioms.example_zh: 我们当初就不该雇用他——首先，他缺乏相关经验。

idioms.meaning: 根本无法/远未能够（描述、表达或解决某事）
idioms.example_en: Words cannot begin to express how grateful we are for your support.
idioms.example_zh: 言语根本无法表达我们对您支持的感激之情。

collocations.example_en: I began to realize that the problem was far more complicated than expected.
collocations.example_zh: 我开始意识到这个问题远比预想的要复杂。

collocations.example_en: After the bankruptcy, the entrepreneur was determined to begin anew.
collocations.example_zh: 破产之后，这位创业者决心重新起步。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 侍候，服侍；等待（决定或结果）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: She spent the summer waiting on tables at a seaside restaurant; we are still waiting on official approval.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 她整个夏天都在海滨餐馆端盘子服侍客人；我们目前仍在等待官方批准。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 耐心等待直到…结束
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The hikers sought shelter in a cave to wait out the blizzard.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 徒步旅行者在洞穴中避难，等待暴风雪停息。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 熬夜等候；（常用于祈使句）等等某人
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Don't wait up for me tonight; I will be working late at the office.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 今晚别熬夜等我了，我会在办公室加班到很晚。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 无所事事地干等
phrasal_verbs.example_en: We had to wait around at the airport for five hours due to flight delays.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 由于航班延误，我们不得不在机场无所事事地干等了五个小时。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 等待；等候
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Customers were patiently waiting for the store to open its doors on Black Friday.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 顾客们正在黑色星期五耐心等候商店开门。

idioms.meaning: 观望；拭目以待
idioms.example_en: We cannot predict the market trend yet, so we will just have to wait and see.
idioms.example_zh: 我们目前还无法预测市场趋势，因此只能静观其变。

idioms.meaning: 埋伏以待；潜伏准备袭击
idioms.example_en: The predator lay in wait among the tall grasses for unsuspecting prey.
idioms.example_zh: 捕食者埋伏在茂密的草丛中，等待毫无防备的猎物。

idioms.meaning: 随时准备接替或登场；跃跃欲试
idioms.example_en: Several talented junior executives are waiting in the wings to take over leadership.
idioms.example_zh: 几位才华横溢的年轻高管正随时准备接管领导权。

collocations.example_en: Please wait patiently while your application is being processed.
collocations.example_zh: 在您的申请处理期间，请耐心等待。

collocations.example_en: Hundreds of fans waited in line overnight to purchase concert tickets.
collocations.example_zh: 数百名歌迷通宵排队购买演唱会门票。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 排列成；组装成；凝结成
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The marching band formed into a giant crest in the center of the stadium.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 军乐队在体育场中央排列成了一个巨大的队徽形状。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （部队或队伍）整队；排成队形
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The soldiers formed up in columns before advancing toward the checkpoint.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 士兵们在向检查站前进前整队排成纵队。

idioms.meaning: 不出所料；一如既往（通常指表现出习惯性的特点）
idioms.example_en: True to form, Mark arrived twenty minutes late for the staff meeting.
idioms.example_zh: 不出所料，马克员工例会又迟到了二十分钟。

idioms.meaning: 以任何形式；不论以何种方式
idioms.example_en: Discrimination in any shape or form will not be tolerated in this workplace.
