phrasal_verbs.example_en: We should invite our new neighbours over for dinner this weekend.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 这个周末我们应该请新邻居来家里吃顿晚饭。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 请（某人）进屋
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Don't leave them standing on the porch; invite them in.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 别让他们站在门廊上，快请他们进屋。

collocations.example_en: Leaving your car unlocked in this neighbourhood is just inviting trouble.
collocations.example_zh: 在这个街区把车不锁门停着简直就是自找麻烦。

collocations.meaning: 征询提问；欢迎发表意见
collocations.example_en: The speaker concluded her presentation and invited questions from the floor.
collocations.example_zh: 主讲人结束了演讲，并欢迎在场听众提问。

collocations.phrase: warmly invite sb to do sth
collocations.example_en: The committee warmly invites scholars from all over the world to submit their papers.
collocations.example_zh: 委员会热忱邀请全球学者踊跃投稿。

idioms.meaning: 对某人作威作福；盛气凌人
idioms.example_en: Ever since she received that minor promotion, she’s been queening it over the whole department.
idioms.example_zh: 自从升了一次小职后，她就对整个部门的同事作威作福。

collocations.meaning: （国际象棋中）将兵升变为王后
collocations.example_en: In the endgame, the grandmaster managed to push his passed pawn forward and queen it.
collocations.example_zh: 在残局阶段，特级大师成功推进通路兵并将其升变为王后。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 从（工作、岗位、运动生涯）退休或退役
phrasal_verbs.example_en: She announced her decision to retire from professional tennis at the end of the season.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 她宣布决定在本赛季结束时退出职业网坛。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 退避到（安静处）；移居某地安度晚年
phrasal_verbs.example_en: After dinner, the guests retired to the library for coffee.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 晚饭后，客人们移步书房去喝咖啡。

idioms.meaning: （板球等运动中）因伤退赛；（引申）受挫而退；铩羽而归
idioms.example_en: After fierce questioning by the committee, the minister effectively retired hurt.
idioms.example_zh: 在遭到委员会的激烈质询后，这位部长实际上已经狼狈退场。

collocations.example_en: He invested wisely in his thirties, allowing him to retire early at fifty.
collocations.example_zh: 他在三十多岁时投资得当，使得他五十岁就能提前退休。

collocations.example_en: It has been an exhausting day, so I shall retire for the night.
collocations.example_zh: 今天真是筋疲力尽的一天，所以我先回房睡了。

collocations.example_en: Ornithologists frequently bird the coastal wetlands during the spring migration season.
collocations.example_zh: 鸟类学者经常在春季迁徙期前往沿海湿地观鸟。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 点击（链接、图标、按钮等）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Click on the attachment to download the PDF file directly to your device.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 点击附件即可将PDF文件直接下载到你的设备上。

collocations.meaning: 咔嗒一声就位；（事实、道理）豁然开朗，各方面理顺
collocations.example_en: As soon as he explained the missing detail, everything clicked into place.
collocations.example_zh: 他一解释那个遗漏的细节，所有的疑点瞬间就全说得通了。

collocations.example_en: They clicked with each other the very first time they met at the conference.
collocations.example_zh: 他们在会议上初次见面就一见如故、十分投缘。

collocations.example_en: Double-click the installer icon to begin setting up the software.
collocations.example_zh: 双击安装图标以开始安装软件。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 从……中获利；从……中吸取教训
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Many export companies profited enormously from the devaluation of the currency.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 许多出口企业从货币贬值中获得了巨额利润。

collocations.example_en: Early investors in the startup profited handsomely when the company went public.
collocations.example_zh: 这家初创公司的早期投资者在公司上市时大赚了一笔。

collocations.meaning: 有望获利；很有可能受益
collocations.example_en: Renewable energy firms stand to profit from the new climate legislation.
collocations.example_zh: 可再生能源公司势必将从新的气候法案中受益。

idioms.phrase: not trouble one's head about sth
idioms.meaning: 不必为某事操心或劳神
idioms.example_en: Don't trouble your head about the cost of the repairs; insurance will cover it.
idioms.example_zh: 别为维修费用操心，保险公司会全额赔付的。

collocations.meaning: （客套礼貌地）劳驾某人；麻烦某人拿……
collocations.example_en: Excuse me, sir, may I trouble you for the salt?
collocations.example_zh: 打扰一下，先生，能麻烦您把盐递给我吗？

collocations.meaning: 对……深感不安；为……忧心忡忡
collocations.example_en: Educators are deeply troubled by the declining literacy rates among teenagers.
collocations.example_zh: 教育工作者对青少年识字率的下降深感忧虑。

collocations.meaning: 懒得做某事；不费心做某事
collocations.example_en: He didn't even trouble to write back and decline the invitation.
collocations.example_zh: 他甚至连回封信拒绝邀请都懒得去做。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 把（物品、球员、资金等）借出
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The municipal museum frequently loans out historical artefacts to foreign galleries.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 该市立博物馆经常将历史文物出借给外国美术馆。

collocations.example_en: The bank refused to loan money to individuals with poor credit history.
collocations.example_zh: 银行拒绝向信用记录不良的个人发放贷款。

collocations.example_en: Could you loan me your car for the afternoon so I can pick up my parents?
collocations.example_zh: 今天下午能把你的车借我用一下去接我父母吗？

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （牲畜等）催肥；养肥
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Cattle are placed in feedlots to fat up quickly before going to market.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 肉牛被关在育肥场里迅速催肥，以便上市销售。

idioms.meaning: （源自圣经动词过去分词）设宴接风；盛情款待归客
idioms.example_en: When our son finally returned from overseas, we killed the fatted calf to celebrate.
idioms.example_zh: 当我们的儿子终于从国外归来时，我们摆下盛宴为他接风洗尘。

collocations.example_en: The ranchers focus on grazing and fatting livestock during the lush summer months.
collocations.example_zh: 牧场主们专注于在水草丰美的夏季放牧并催肥牲畜。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 有……的味道；有……的迹象或意味
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The tap water tasted of chlorine.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 自来水尝起来有一股氯气味。

idioms.meaning: 初尝甜头（指尝到胜利或支配的滋味而变得更加贪婪凶猛）
idioms.example_en: Having won the first match, the young team tasted blood and pushed for the championship.
idioms.example_zh: 赢下首场比赛后，这支年轻的队伍尝到了甜头，全力冲击冠军。

collocations.meaning: 品尝失败/胜利/成功的滋味
collocations.example_en: The champion tasted defeat for the first time in five years.
collocations.example_zh: 这位冠军五年来首次尝到了失败的滋味。

collocations.example_en: The medicine tastes bitter, but it will help your cough.
collocations.example_zh: 这药尝起来很苦，但能缓解你的咳嗽。

collocations.example_en: The agency is licensed to sell tickets on behalf of the airline.
collocations.example_zh: 该代理商获得了代表该航空公司售票的许可。

collocations.example_en: They agreed to license their proprietary technology to third-party developers.
collocations.example_zh: 他们同意将专利技术授权给第三方开发者使用。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 分解为；化为
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The discussion gradually resolved into an argument over funding.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 讨论渐渐演变成了关于资金问题的争论。

collocations.example_en: Diplomats are working around the clock to resolve the border dispute peacefully.
collocations.example_zh: 外交官们正夜以继日地工作，力求和平化解边境争端。

collocations.example_en: She resolved to work harder and secure a scholarship next semester.
collocations.example_zh: 她下定决心更加努力，争取下学期拿奖学金。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 以……结束；以……告终
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The concert concluded with a breathtaking performance of the national anthem.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 音乐会在令人惊艳的国歌演奏中落下帷幕。

collocations.example_en: After months of negotiation, both sides concluded a free trade agreement.
collocations.example_zh: 经过数月的谈判，双方达成了自由贸易协定。

collocations.example_en: The researchers concluded that the new drug was both safe and effective.
collocations.example_zh: 研究人员得出结论，认为新药既安全又有效。

collocations.meaning: 给金属/木材涂日本漆（黑亮乌漆）
collocations.example_en: Artisans used to japan sheet metal to prevent rusting and provide a glossy finish.
collocations.example_zh: 工匠们过去常给金属薄板涂黑漆，以防锈并呈现光泽饰面。

idioms.meaning: 勇者天佑；天佑勇者
idioms.example_en: Take the risk and launch the startup—fortune favors the bold.
idioms.example_zh: 冒一次险创立这家公司吧——天佑勇者。

collocations.meaning: 支持/倾向于某提议/方案/方法
collocations.example_en: Most committee members favored a cautious approach to the reform.
collocations.example_zh: 多数委员会成员倾向于对改革采取谨慎的方法。

collocations.example_en: The current tax system strongly favors high-income earners.
collocations.example_zh: 当前的税收制度明显偏向高收入群体。

idioms.meaning: 渡过难关；经受住严峻考验
idioms.example_en: The airline managed to weather the storm caused by rising fuel costs.
idioms.example_zh: 这家航空公司成功渡过了因燃油成本上涨带来的危机。

collocations.example_en: Thanks to strong cash reserves, the bank easily weathered the economic crisis.
collocations.example_zh: 得益于雄厚的现金储备，该银行轻松挺过了这场经济危机。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 引用自；援引……的话
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The professor quoted extensively from Shakespeare's sonnets.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 教授大量引用了莎士比亚十四行诗中的内容。

collocations.example_en: The contractor quoted a price of $5,000 for the kitchen renovation.
collocations.example_zh: 承包商对厨房装修开出了 5000 美元的报价。

collocations.example_en: His groundbreaking paper is still widely quoted in academic circles.
collocations.example_zh: 他的开创性论文在学术界依然被广泛引用。

collocations.meaning: 对嫌疑人/罪犯进行侧写（心理与行为画像）
collocations.example_en: Behavioral analysts were brought in to profile the serial arsonist.
collocations.example_zh: 行为分析专家受邀对连环纵火犯进行画像侧写。

collocations.meaning: 在……中被作人物专访/特写报道
collocations.example_en: The young entrepreneur was profiled in Forbes magazine last month.
collocations.example_zh: 上个月《福布斯》杂志对这位年轻企业家进行了专题报道。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 挥手示意招停（车辆或司机）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The police officer stood in the middle of the road and waved the speeding car down.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 警察站在路中央挥手招停了那辆超速行驶的汽车。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 挥手打发；对……不予理会或不屑一顾
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The CEO waved aside questions about his impending retirement.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 总裁对手下提出的关于他即将退休的问题不予理会。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 挥手放行；示意某人通过（关卡）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The border guard checked our passports and waved us through.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 边检人员检查了我们的护照后挥手放行。

idioms.meaning: 告别某物；不得不放弃某事
idioms.example_en: If you fail this exam, you can wave goodbye to your university dream.
idioms.example_zh: 如果这次考试不及格，你的大学梦就只能泡汤了。

idioms.meaning: 举白旗投降；承认失败认输
idioms.example_en: After hours of relentless questioning, the suspect finally waved the white flag.
idioms.example_zh: 在持续数小时的严厉审讯后，嫌疑人最终认输交代了。

collocations.example_en: You can't just wave a magic wand and make all these problems disappear.
collocations.example_zh: 你不能指望挥一挥魔杖，所有问题就迎刃而解。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 在……方面表现卓越；极其擅长
phrasal_verbs.example_en: From an early age, she excelled in mathematics and logical reasoning.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 她从小就在数学和逻辑推理方面表现出过人天赋。

collocations.meaning: 超越自我；超越平时的水平
collocations.example_en: The chef really excelled himself with this seven-course tasting menu.
collocations.example_zh: 主厨用这套七道菜的品鉴菜单真正超越了自我。

collocations.example_en: The company continues to excel in customer satisfaction surveys.
collocations.example_zh: 该公司在客户满意度调查中持续保持优异表现。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 把……塑造成；手工制作成
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The artist fashioned scrap metal into a stunning sculpture of an eagle.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 艺术家将废金属塑造成了一尊令人惊叹的雄鹰雕塑。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 用……制作出；就地取材制作
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Survivors fashioned a makeshift raft from fallen tree trunks.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 幸存者们用倒下的树干做成了一艘简易木筏。

collocations.example_en: Leaders met behind closed doors to fashion a coherent foreign policy.
collocations.example_zh: 领导人们闭门磋商，以制定出一套协调统一的外交政策。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 成对结伴；两人一组合作
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The teacher asked the students to pair up for the science experiment.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 老师让学生们结对进行科学实验。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 结成情侣；成双成对
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Most of my college friends have paired off and started families.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我大学时的大多数朋友都已经成家立业了。

collocations.meaning: 与……搭配（常用于餐酒搭配或软硬件配合）
collocations.example_en: This full-bodied red wine pairs beautifully with roasted lamb.
collocations.example_zh: 这款浓郁的红葡萄酒与烤羊肉堪称绝配。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 热身；加热（饭菜）；（气氛）活跃起来；（机器）预热
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Always spend ten minutes warming up before lifting heavy weights.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在进行大重量力量训练前，务必花十分钟进行热身。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 开始对……有好感；逐渐赞同（某想法）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The board members initially resisted the merger, but slowly warmed to the idea.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 董事会成员起初抵触并购，但逐渐接受并赞同了这个想法。

idioms.phrase: warm the cockles of one's heart
idioms.meaning: 使人感到由衷温暖；令人心生慰藉
idioms.example_en: Seeing the community rally to support the family really warmed the cockles of my heart.
idioms.example_zh: 看到社区居民齐心协力帮助那家人，真让人心里感到无比温暖。

collocations.meaning: 温暖某人的心；让某人感动
collocations.example_en: The children's handmade cards genuinely warmed her heart.
collocations.example_zh: 孩子们亲手制作的卡片深深温暖了她的心。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 拆除（建筑物）；贬低/抨击（某人）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The old factory was torn down to make way for a modern shopping mall.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 那座旧工厂被拆除，以便改建现代化的购物中心。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 撕碎；使（群体/国家）分崩离析；使某人心碎
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The civil war threatens to tear the entire country apart.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 内战有让整个国家分崩离析的危险。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 撕毁（文件、条约）；（眼眶）泛起泪光
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He tore up the draft agreement in frustration and walked out of the room.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他沮丧地撕毁了协议草案，甩门而去。

idioms.meaning: 在……之间进退两难；难以抉择
idioms.example_en: She was torn between pursuing a lucrative corporate job and following her artistic passion.
idioms.example_zh: 她在追求高薪企业工作和追随艺术热情之间左右为难。

collocations.meaning: 撕成碎片；把（观点、计划）批得体无完肤
collocations.example_en: Critics tore the director's latest film to shreds.
collocations.example_zh: 影评人把这位导演的最新电影批得体无完肤。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （工厂）装置机器设备；配备武器装备
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The manufacturing plant is tooling up to begin electric vehicle production.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 该制造工厂正在升级设备，准备投入电动汽车的生产。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 开车闲逛；四处兜风
phrasal_verbs.example_en: We spent Saturday afternoon tooling around the countryside in an old convertible.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 周六下午我们开着一辆老式敞篷车在乡间兜风闲逛。

collocations.meaning: 为……重组/调整业务或设备
collocations.example_en: The company had to re-tool its operations for the digital era.
collocations.example_zh: 该公司不得不重塑业务模式以适应数字时代。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 往往会/倾向于；照料/处理（事务、伤病）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Paramedics quickly arrived on the scene to tend to the wounded passengers.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 医护人员迅速赶赴现场照料受伤的乘客。

collocations.example_en: Nurses worked around the clock tending the sick during the outbreak.
collocations.example_zh: 疫情期间，护士们夜以继日地照料病患。

collocations.meaning: 当酒吧调酒师；照看吧台
collocations.example_en: He tended bar on weekends to help pay his university tuition.
collocations.example_zh: 他周末去酒吧当调酒师，以补贴大学学费。

collocations.example_en: Lower interest rates are intended to encourage business investment and economic growth.
collocations.example_zh: 降低利率旨在刺激商业投资与经济增长。

collocations.example_en: Authorities strongly encourage residents to evacuate before the hurricane makes landfall.
collocations.example_zh: 当局强烈建议居民在飓风登陆前紧急撤离。

collocations.example_en: The workshop is designed to encourage active participation from all attendees.
collocations.example_zh: 该研讨会旨在鼓励所有与会者积极参与互动。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 把……排除在……之外
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Several key witnesses were excluded from giving evidence in court.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 数名关键证人被排除在出庭作证之外。

collocations.example_en: The medical examiner could not completely exclude the possibility of foul play.
collocations.example_zh: 法医尚无法完全排除谋杀的可能性。

collocations.example_en: The insurance policy expressly excludes coverage for pre-existing medical conditions.
collocations.example_zh: 该保单已明确将既往病史排除在理赔范围之外。

collocations.example_en: I deeply appreciate the time and guidance you have given me throughout this project.
collocations.example_zh: 我非常感激你在整个项目中给予我的时间和悉心指导。

collocations.example_en: Properties in this coastal district have appreciated substantially over the last five years.
collocations.example_zh: 该沿海区域的房产在过去五年里大幅升值。

collocations.meaning: 充分领会/意识到……的重要性
collocations.example_en: Many young entrepreneurs fail to fully appreciate the importance of cash flow management.
collocations.example_zh: 许多年轻创业者未能充分意识到现金流管理的重要性。

collocations.example_en: He was selected to captain the national team in the upcoming World Cup.
collocations.example_zh: 他入选并在即将到来的世界杯上担任国家队队长。

collocations.meaning: 担任船长；担任机长执飞
collocations.example_en: She captained the flight safely through a severe thunderstorm.
collocations.example_zh: 她作为机长沉着指挥，使航班安全穿过了强雷暴区。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 防范；防止；警惕
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Organizations must implement strict measures to guard against cyber attacks.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 机构必须采取严密措施以防范网络攻击。

idioms.meaning: 谨言慎行；说话留神
idioms.example_en: In politically sensitive meetings, it is always wise to guard your tongue.
idioms.example_zh: 在政治敏感的会议上，谨言慎行向来是明智之举。

idioms.meaning: 誓死捍卫；用生命保护
idioms.example_en: The soldiers were sworn to guard the secret base with their lives.
idioms.example_zh: 战士们发誓要用生命保卫该秘密基地。

collocations.example_en: The formula of the drink remains a closely guarded trade secret.
collocations.example_zh: 这款饮料的配方依然是一项被严加保密的商业机密。

collocations.example_en: Armed patrols were deployed to guard the northern border.
collocations.example_zh: 武装巡逻队被派去守卫北部边境。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 越冬；过冬
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Many species of migratory birds winter over in these mild southern wetlands.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 许多候鸟在这些气候温和的南方湿地越冬。

collocations.example_en: A growing number of northern retirees choose to winter in Florida.
collocations.example_zh: 越来越多的北方退休人员选择去佛罗里达州过冬。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 向……告密；向……通风报信
phrasal_verbs.example_en: An anonymous insider tipped off the police about the planned heist.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 一名匿名知情人士向警方告密，透露了蓄谋已久的抢劫计划。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （使）翻倒；（使）倾覆
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The cat jumped onto the table and accidentally tipped over the vase.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 猫跳到桌上，不小心打翻了花瓶。

idioms.meaning: 打破平衡；扭转局势；起到决定性作用
idioms.example_en: Her endorsement tipped the scales in favor of the controversial bill.
idioms.example_zh: 她的支持起到了决定性作用，使局面偏向了这项颇具争议的法案。

collocations.meaning: 被广泛看好（做某事）；被预测会……
collocations.example_en: The young director is widely tipped to win an Academy Award this year.
collocations.example_zh: 这位年轻导演被业界普遍看好有望在今年斩获奥斯卡奖。

collocations.example_en: He always tips generously when he receives exceptional service.
collocations.example_zh: 当享受到周到的服务时，他总是很大方地给小费。

collocations.example_en: The traffic officer ticketed the driver for running a red light.
collocations.example_zh: 交警因该司机闯红灯而对其开具了罚单。

collocations.meaning: 持票前往；已预订前往……的机票/车票
collocations.example_en: Passengers ticketed to London were asked to proceed to Gate 12.
collocations.example_zh: 持有前往伦敦机票的旅客请前往12号登机口。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 从……浮出水面；从……露出
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The submarine surfaced from the icy depths of the ocean at dawn.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 潜艇在黎明时分从冰冷的海洋深处浮出了水面。

collocations.meaning: （紧张情绪、疑虑等隐性问题）显露；浮出水面
collocations.example_en: Long-standing resentments began to surface during the negotiations.
collocations.example_zh: 积压已久的不满情绪在谈判过程中开始显露出来。

collocations.meaning: 公开露面；在网络上浮现/曝光
collocations.example_en: New video evidence surfaced online shortly after the press conference.
collocations.example_zh: 新闻发布会后不久，新的视频证据就在网络上曝光了。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 非法交易；贩运（毒品、军火等）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The criminal syndicate was convicted of trafficking in illegal weapons.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 该犯罪辛迪加因非法走私军火而被定罪。

collocations.example_en: International task forces work tirelessly to rescue women trafficked across borders.
collocations.example_zh: 国际特别行动小组不懈努力，解救被跨境拐卖的女性受害者。

collocations.meaning: 走私/贩运毒品/野生动物
collocations.example_en: Severe penalties were introduced to stop poachers from trafficking wildlife parts.
collocations.example_zh: 当局出台了严厉的刑罚，以遏制盗猎分子贩卖野生动物制品的行为。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 因……感到刺痛；因……耿耿于怀/备受煎熬
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The incumbent party is still smarting from its humiliating election defeat.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 执政党仍在为上次选举中耻辱性的惨败而耿耿于怀。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 在……之下感到难堪/痛苦
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He smarted under his supervisor's harsh and public criticism.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在主管严厉且公开的批评下，他感到极为难堪和委屈。

collocations.example_en: Her eyes were smarting from the heavy smoke in the kitchen.
collocations.example_zh: 厨房里浓重的油烟熏得她眼睛发痛。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （用大客车/公车）运进 / 接走（人员）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Volunteers were bussed in from neighbouring towns to assist with disaster relief.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 志愿者们被大巴从邻近城镇接送过来协助救灾。

collocations.meaning: （在餐馆）收拾清理餐桌；收餐具
collocations.example_en: He worked his way through college by bussing tables at a local diner.
collocations.example_zh: 他通过在当地餐馆收拾餐桌打工，勤工俭学读完了大学。

collocations.example_en: The district buses thousands of rural students to regional schools every day.
collocations.example_zh: 该学区每天用校车接送数千名乡村学生前往中心学校就读。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 顶嘴；大放厥词，粗鲁或狂妄地说话
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He got into trouble for mouthing off to the referee.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他因为顶撞裁判而惹上了麻烦。

collocations.meaning: 无声地对口型；只动嘴皮子跟着说或唱
collocations.example_en: She stood on the stage, mouthing the words along with the playback.
collocations.example_zh: 她站在舞台上，跟着伴奏对口型。

collocations.meaning: 空口说陈词滥调；空谈套话
collocations.example_en: Politicians often mouth platitudes without offering real solutions.
collocations.example_zh: 政客们常常满嘴套话，却拿不出实质性的解决方案。

collocations.meaning: 使某人想起；在样貌或特质上使人联想到
collocations.example_en: That melody always reminds me of my college years.
collocations.example_zh: 那段旋律总能让我想起我的大学时光。

collocations.example_en: Please remind me to submit the quarterly report before noon.
collocations.example_zh: 请提醒我在中午前提交季度报告。

collocations.meaning: 委婉地提醒；温和地提示
collocations.example_en: The manager gently reminded the team about the upcoming deadline.
collocations.example_zh: 经理温和地提醒团队即将到来的截止日期。

collocations.meaning: 使某人处于有利地位；有利于某人
collocations.example_en: The proposed tax reform will primarily advantage large export corporations.
collocations.example_zh: 拟议中的税制改革将主要有利于大型出口企业。

collocations.example_en: Students who are advantaged by private tutoring often score higher on standardized tests.
collocations.example_zh: 得益于私人家教辅导的学生往往在标准化考试中取得更高分数。

collocations.example_en: Over two hundred delegates participated in the international climate summit.
collocations.example_zh: 两百多位代表参加了此次国际气候峰会。

collocations.example_en: Students are strongly encouraged to actively participate in seminar discussions.
collocations.example_zh: 学校强烈鼓励学生积极参与研讨课的讨论。

collocations.meaning: 全方位参与；全情投入参与
collocations.example_en: The rehabilitation program enables patients to participate fully in daily life again.
collocations.example_zh: 该康复计划使患者能够再次全面回归并融入日常生活。

collocations.example_en: The mayor was accused of abusing his authority to secure contracts for his family.
collocations.example_zh: 市长被指控滥用职权为其家族谋取合同。

collocations.example_en: Passengers who verbally abuse airline staff will face severe penalties.
collocations.example_zh: 对航空公司地勤及机组人员进行言语辱骂的乘客将面临严厉处罚。

collocations.meaning: 滥用违禁药物；吸毒成瘾
collocations.example_en: He entered a rehabilitation clinic after years of abusing prescription drugs.
collocations.example_zh: 在多年滥用处方药之后，他进入了一家戒毒康复诊所。

collocations.meaning: 捍卫/支持某项事业；为某一理想大声疾呼
collocations.example_en: She dedicated her entire career to championing the cause of social justice.
collocations.example_zh: 她将毕生职业生涯奉献给了捍卫社会正义的事业。

collocations.example_en: The organization continues to champion human rights around the globe.
collocations.example_zh: 该组织持续在世界各地捍卫人权。

collocations.example_en: The new governor has promised to champion educational reform across the state.
collocations.example_zh: 新任州长承诺将在全州范围内力推教育改革。

collocations.meaning: 在谷歌上搜索某事物；上网搜寻
collocations.example_en: If you don't know the answer, just google it on your phone.
collocations.example_zh: 如果你不知道答案，拿手机搜一下就行了。

collocations.meaning: 在网上搜自己的名字（看他人对自己有何评价）
collocations.example_en: Curious about his digital footprint, he decided to google himself.
collocations.example_zh: 出于对自己网络足迹的好奇，他决定在谷歌上搜一下自己的名字。

idioms.meaning: 克制自己；节制，克己以省下金钱或享受
idioms.example_en: She denied herself any luxuries so that her children could attend university.
idioms.example_zh: 她省吃俭用克制一切奢求，以便让孩子们能读上大学。

collocations.example_en: The spokesperson flatly denied the allegations of financial misconduct.
collocations.example_zh: 发言人断然否认了有关财务不当行为的指控。

collocations.meaning: 拒绝入境；拒不提供访问权限
collocations.example_en: Inspectors were denied access to the military facility.
collocations.example_zh: 视察人员被拒绝进入该军事设施。

collocations.meaning: 不可否认的是…；毋庸置疑
collocations.example_en: There is no denying that technological progress has transformed the job market.
collocations.example_zh: 不可否认，技术进步已经彻底改变了就业市场。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 把…藏好；躲避避世，幽居
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The author hid away in a remote cottage to finish writing her novel.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 这位作家躲在偏远的小屋里避世闭关，以完成她的小说。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 潜藏，躲藏避难（尤指逃避追捕或危险）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The fugitive had been hiding out in an abandoned warehouse for weeks.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 逃犯在一家废弃仓库里潜藏了数周。

idioms.phrase: hide one's light under a bushel
idioms.meaning: 深藏不露；过分谦虚，隐藏自己的才华
idioms.example_en: Don't hide your light under a bushel—let the management see what you are capable of.
idioms.example_zh: 不要过分韬光养晦，让管理层看到你的真正实力。

collocations.example_en: They tried to hide the truth about the environmental spill from the public.
collocations.example_zh: 他们试图向公众隐瞒有关环境泄漏的真相。

collocations.meaning: 掩饰情绪；克制感情流露
collocations.example_en: He could barely hide his disappointment when he heard the verdict.
collocations.example_zh: 听到判决结果时，他几乎无法掩饰自己的失望之情。

collocations.meaning: 完全忽视；根本置之不理
collocations.example_en: The company completely ignored repeated warnings from safety inspectors.
collocations.example_zh: 该公司完全置安全检查员的反复警告于不顾。

collocations.example_en: Hikers who ignore weather warnings put their lives at grave risk.
collocations.example_zh: 忽视天气预警的登山者是将自己的生命置于极度危险之中。

collocations.example_en: Rising customer dissatisfaction is a trend the board cannot afford to ignore.
collocations.example_zh: 客户满意度下滑是董事会决不能忽视的趋势。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 容许，有……的余地（正式或文学用法）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The urgent situation permits of no delay.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 危急局势容不得半点拖延。

idioms.meaning: 如果时间/天气允许的话
idioms.example_en: We plan to have a barbecue in the garden tomorrow, weather permitting.
idioms.example_zh: 如果天气允许，我们打算明天在花园里烧烤。

collocations.example_en: Visitors are not permitted entry without a valid pass.
collocations.example_zh: 没有有效通行证的访客不得入内。

collocations.example_en: We will expand into the overseas market next year if circumstances permit.
collocations.example_zh: 如果情况允许，我们将在明年开拓海外市场。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （价格、经济或萧条期）见底企稳，止跌回升
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Economists predict that the recession has finally bottomed out.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 经济学家预测这次经济衰退终于见底企稳了。

collocations.example_en: The company's stock price bottomed out at twenty dollars before recovering.
collocations.example_zh: 该公司的股价在跌至二十美元后触底反弹。

collocations.example_en: The school decided to adopt a more flexible approach to teaching.
collocations.example_zh: 学校决定采取一种更加灵活的教学方法。

collocations.example_en: The government adopted strict measures to curb inflation.
collocations.example_zh: 政府采取严厉措施以抑制通货膨胀。

collocations.example_en: They decided to adopt a child after years of struggling with infertility.
collocations.example_zh: 在多年受不孕困扰后，他们决定领养一个孩子。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 源自，来自；由……产生
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Many of our modern environmental problems flow from industrial overdevelopment.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我们许多现代环境问题都源自工业的过度开发。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 涌入；源源不断地流进
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Donations have been flowing into the charity since the disaster occurred.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 自灾难发生以来，善款不断涌入该慈善机构。

collocations.example_en: Once the awkward ice was broken, conversation flowed freely.
collocations.example_zh: 尴尬的气氛被打破后，大家谈笑风生，聊得很顺畅。

collocations.example_en: Traffic flowed smoothly despite the heavy snow.
collocations.example_zh: 尽管下着大雪，交通依然顺畅通行。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 把……编入预算；为……预留费用或时间
phrasal_verbs.example_en: We forgot to budget for contingency expenses when planning the trip.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我们在做旅行预算时，忘了把应急开支计算在内。

collocations.meaning: 精打细算；合理规划预算
collocations.example_en: College students often have to budget carefully to make ends meet.
collocations.example_zh: 大学生往往需要精打细算才能勉强维持收支平衡。

collocations.example_en: You need to budget your time effectively during the exam.
collocations.example_zh: 你在考试期间需要合理规划好自己的时间。

collocations.example_en: Patients who display symptoms of infection must be isolated immediately.
collocations.example_zh: 表现出感染症状的患者必须立即被隔离。

collocations.example_en: The young pianist displayed remarkable talent at the competition.
collocations.example_zh: 这位年轻的钢琴家在比赛中展现了非凡的才华。

collocations.example_en: He rarely displays his emotions in front of strangers.
collocations.example_zh: 他很少在陌生人面前流露自己的情感。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 鱼贯进入/涌出；连绵不断地出入
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Thousands of fans began streaming into the stadium hours before the concert.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 早在演唱会开始数小时前，数千名歌迷就开始涌入体育场。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 顺着……流下；倾泻而下
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Tears streamed down her cheeks as she listened to the heartbreaking story.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 听着那令人心碎的故事，泪水顺着她的脸颊止不住地流下。

collocations.example_en: The keynote speech will be streamed live on several social platforms.
collocations.example_zh: 该主题演讲将在多个社交平台上进行在线直播。

collocations.meaning: 在线收听/观看流媒体音频或视频
collocations.example_en: Most people prefer streaming music online rather than buying physical albums.
collocations.example_zh: 大多数人更喜欢在线收听流媒体音乐，而不是购买实体专辑。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 把……瞄准；针对；旨在，目标是
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The new government policy is aimed at reducing youth unemployment.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 政府出台的新政策旨在降低青年失业率。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 力求达到，以……为奋斗目标
phrasal_verbs.example_en: We are aiming for a ten percent increase in sales this quarter.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我们力求在本季度实现销售额增长百分之十。

collocations.meaning: 志存高远，树立远大目标
collocations.example_en: My parents always encouraged me to aim high in my career.
collocations.example_zh: 父母总是鼓励我在事业上要志存高远。

collocations.example_en: The advertising campaign is directly aimed at teenage consumers.
collocations.example_zh: 这场广告宣传活动是直接面向青少年消费者的。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 聚集在一起；聚集，集结
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Dark storm clouds were massing together on the horizon.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 乌云正在地平线上聚拢。

collocations.phrase: troops mass at / on the border
collocations.example_en: Tensions escalated as foreign troops massed along the northern border.
collocations.example_zh: 随着外国军队在北部边境集结，局势急剧升级。

collocations.example_en: Dense grey clouds massed overhead, threatening heavy rain.
collocations.example_zh: 头顶密布着厚重的乌云，预示着一场大雨将至。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 对……表示抗议，反对
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Thousands marched through the city to protest against the proposed tax hike.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 数千人穿过城市游行，抗议提议的增税方案。

idioms.meaning: 辩解得过火；极力掩饰（显得欲盖弥彰）
idioms.example_en: His constant denial made everyone think he was protesting too much.
idioms.example_zh: 他一再矢口否认，反而让大家都觉得他是欲盖弥彰。

collocations.meaning: 辩白自己无罪，坚称清白
collocations.example_en: Even after his conviction, he continued to protest his innocence.
collocations.example_zh: 即使在被定罪之后，他仍然坚称自己是清白的。

collocations.example_en: The coach protested vehemently against the referee's controversial call.
collocations.example_zh: 教练对裁判引发争议的判罚提出了强烈抗议。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 走神；发呆
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I was so tired during the lecture that I completely zoned out.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 听讲座时我实在太累了，整个人完全走神了。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 全神贯注；锁定目标
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Athletes need to zone in before the competition starts.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 运动员在比赛开始前需要高度集中注意力。

collocations.meaning: 将（土地等）划定为（某种用途）
collocations.example_en: The district was zoned for commercial development.
collocations.example_zh: 该区域被规划为商业开发用地。

idioms.meaning: 逐渐喜欢上；养成对……的爱好
idioms.example_en: She slowly acquired a taste for classical music after attending live concerts.
idioms.example_zh: 在听过现场音乐会后，她渐渐喜欢上了古典音乐。

collocations.example_en: Internships allow students to acquire practical skills.
collocations.example_zh: 实习让学生们能够学到实用技能。

collocations.example_en: The tech giant recently acquired a promising AI startup.
collocations.example_zh: 该科技巨头近期收购了一家前景广阔的AI初创公司。

collocations.example_en: Over the years, the firm has acquired a reputation for reliability.
collocations.example_zh: 多年来，该事务所树立起了可靠的声誉。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 成功做到某事
phrasal_verbs.example_en: After months of negotiations, they succeeded in reaching an agreement.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 经过数月的谈判，他们终于成功达成了协议。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 继承（王位、头衔或财产）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He succeeded to the throne following the death of his mother.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 母亲去世后，他继承了王位。

collocations.example_en: She will succeed him as the company's chief executive next month.
collocations.example_zh: 她将于下月接替他出任公司首席执行官。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 安排；筹备
phrasal_verbs.example_en: We have arranged for a taxi to pick you up at the airport.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我们已经安排了一辆出租车去机场接你。

collocations.example_en: Can we arrange a quick meeting tomorrow to discuss the budget?
collocations.example_zh: 我们明天能安排一次简短会议来讨论预算吗？

collocations.example_en: She spent the afternoon rearranging the living room furniture.
collocations.example_zh: 她花了一个下午重新摆放客厅的家具。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 向……打手势；示意某人
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The referee signaled to the players to resume the game.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 裁判向队员示意继续比赛。

collocations.example_en: The policy shift signaled a new era in foreign relations.
collocations.example_zh: 该政策的转变标志着对外关系进入了一个新时代。

collocations.example_en: The senator has clearly signaled his intention to run for office.
collocations.example_zh: 这位参议员已明确表达了参选意向。

collocations.example_en: Remember to signal before changing lanes on the highway.
collocations.example_zh: 在高速公路上变道前记得打转向灯。

collocations.example_en: Investors were urged to exercise extreme caution amid market volatility.
collocations.example_zh: 面对市场波动，投资者被敦促保持极度谨慎。

collocations.example_en: Citizens are encouraged to exercise their right to vote.
collocations.example_zh: 鼓励公民积极行使自己的投票权。

collocations.example_en: Doctors advise middle-aged adults to exercise regularly.
collocations.example_zh: 医生建议中年人保持规律锻炼。

collocations.meaning: 在信件/邮件上盖邮资印戳（或享有免费寄信特权）
collocations.example_en: All official outgoing envelopes must be franked before dispatch.
collocations.example_zh: 所有寄出的官方信封在发送前都必须加盖邮资机印。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 回复邮件
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I'll review the report and email you back by noon.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我会先审阅这份报告，并在中午前给你回复邮件。

collocations.example_en: Please don't forget to email the signed contract as an attachment.
collocations.example_zh: 请不要忘记将签好字的合同作为附件通过邮件发送过来。

collocations.meaning: 邮件发送细节/最新进展
collocations.example_en: We will email you full details of the itinerary shortly.
collocations.example_zh: 我们将很快通过电子邮件向您发送完整的行程细节。

idioms.meaning: 垄断市场；囤积居奇
idioms.example_en: The startup aims to corner the market in green energy storage.
idioms.example_zh: 这家初创公司旨在垄断绿色储能市场。

collocations.meaning: 逼入走投无路的境地；堵截
collocations.example_en: The police cornered the suspect in a dead-end alley.
collocations.example_zh: 警方将嫌疑人堵死在一条死胡同里。

collocations.meaning: 拦住某人（迫使其交谈/无法脱身）
collocations.example_en: Reporters cornered the minister as he walked out of the conference.
collocations.example_zh: 部长走出会议室时被记者们拦住问个不停。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 躲藏；潜伏；闭门不出
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The bandits holed up in an abandoned cabin during the blizzard.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 暴风雪期间，强盗们藏身于一间废弃的小木屋里。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （高尔夫）把球击入洞中
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He holed out from forty feet to win the championship.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他从40英尺外一杆进洞，赢得了冠军。

collocations.example_en: The torpedo holed the warship just below the waterline.
collocations.example_zh: 鱼雷在战舰吃水线下方打出了一个大洞。

collocations.example_en: The government launched new training programs to bridge the gap between education and employment.
collocations.example_zh: 政府推出了新的培训项目，以缩小教育与就业之间的差距。

collocations.example_en: Leaders are working together to bridge the political divide across the country.
collocations.example_zh: 领导人们正在共同努力消除全国范围内的政治分歧。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 公开表态支持
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Several prominent senators have declared for the proposed tax reform.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 几位知名参议员已公开表态支持该项税收改革方案。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 公开表态反对
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The union declared against the proposed pay freeze.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 工会公开表态反对拟议的薪资冻结计划。

collocations.example_en: The retail giant was forced to declare bankruptcy after months of declining sales.
collocations.example_zh: 在销售额连续数月下滑后，这家零售巨头被迫宣布破产。

collocations.example_en: The governor declared a state of emergency ahead of the incoming hurricane.
collocations.example_zh: 飓风来临前，州长宣布进入紧急状态。

collocations.example_en: The mayor declared war on urban crime and promised more police patrols.
collocations.example_zh: 市长誓言向城市犯罪全面开战，并承诺增派巡警。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 从……毕业
phrasal_verbs.example_en: She graduated from law school at the top of her class.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 她以全班第一名的优异成绩从法学院毕业。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 晋升至；进而使用/转向（更高级别的事物）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: After mastering the violin, he graduated to composing his own orchestral works.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 熟练掌握小提琴演奏后，他进而开始创作自己的管弦乐作品。

collocations.example_en: He worked tirelessly and managed to graduate with honors in economics.
collocations.example_zh: 他孜孜不倦地努力，最终以优异成绩从经济学专业毕业。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 冲……微笑
phrasal_verbs.example_en: She smiled at the baby, trying to calm him down.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 她微笑着看着小宝宝，试图让他安静下来。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 眷顾；垂青；赞许
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Fortune finally smiled on the struggling entrepreneur.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 命运之神终于垂青了这位苦苦挣扎的创业者。

collocations.example_en: He smiled broadly as he accepted the award on stage.
collocations.example_zh: 他在台上领奖时露出了灿烂的笑容。

collocations.example_en: Disappointed by the result, she still managed to force a smile.
collocations.example_zh: 尽管对结果很失望，她还是勉强挤出了一丝微笑。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 循环轮流；逐一经历
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The billboard cycles through five different advertisements every minute.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 广告牌每分钟循环轮播五则不同的广告。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 循环往复回到；重新谈到
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The conversation eventually cycled back to the issue of budget cuts.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 大家的讨论兜兜转转，最终又回到了削减预算的问题上。

collocations.example_en: More commuters are choosing to cycle to work to stay fit and save money.
collocations.example_zh: 越来越多的上班族选择骑车通勤，以保持健康并节省开支。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 停工；永久关闭；（计算机等）关机
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The factory was forced to shut down due to rising production costs.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 由于生产成本上升，这家工厂被迫关闭。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 关在门外；排除……的可能性；（体育中）零封对手
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Local vendors felt they were being shut out of the lucrative bidding process.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 当地供应商觉得自己被排挤在收益丰厚的竞标流程之外。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 切断（水、电、气等供应）；使隔绝
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Remember to shut off the gas valve before leaving the house.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 出门前务必记得切断燃气阀门。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 闭嘴；把……关起来/禁闭
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He told everyone to shut up so he could hear the news bulletin.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他让大家都闭嘴，好让他能听清新闻简报。

idioms.meaning: 拒绝；排除……的可能
idioms.example_en: The management has shut the door on further negotiations with the union.
idioms.example_zh: 管理层已经排除了与工会进一步谈判的可能性。

collocations.example_en: Keep the windows shut tight to prevent dust from getting inside.
collocations.example_zh: 把窗户关严，防止灰尘钻进室内。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 禁止某人参与/进入……
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The athlete was banned from competitive sports for three years after failing a drug test.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 该运动员因药检未过而被禁止参加竞技体育三年。

collocations.example_en: The city council voted to ban outright the sale of single-use plastics.
collocations.example_zh: 市议会投票决定彻底禁止销售一次性塑料制品。

collocations.example_en: The stringent new regulations effectively ban gas-powered vehicles by 2035.
collocations.example_zh: 严苛的新规实际上相当于在2035年之前全面禁售燃油车。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 吸入；卷入，使身不由己地卷入
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He didn't want any drama, but he was inevitably sucked in.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他本不想惹是生非，却不可避免地被卷了进去。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 逢迎；阿谀奉承
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He spent most of his time trying to suck up to the supervisor.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他把大部分时间都花在阿谀奉承主管上了。

idioms.meaning: 咬牙忍耐；硬着头皮顶住
idioms.example_en: Training was brutal, but the coach told them to suck it up and keep running.
idioms.example_zh: 训练异常残酷，但教练告诉他们要咬牙硬挺、继续奔跑。

collocations.example_en: Legal fees threatened to suck the family's savings dry.
collocations.example_zh: 诉讼费用眼看就要把这个家庭的积蓄吸干。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 打开/关闭（电源等）；突然兴奋/失去兴趣
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Don't forget to switch off the lights when you leave the office.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 离开办公室时别忘了随手关灯。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 转换；切换（频道、系统等）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The hospital will switch over to a completely digital record system next month.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 下个月该医院将全面切换至数字化病历系统。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 不再关注；放松身心
phrasal_verbs.example_en: After a grueling week, she just wanted to switch off and read a novel.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 经历了一周的高压工作，她只想放空大脑、读本小说放松一下。

idioms.meaning: 改变做法；转变方向/思路
idioms.example_en: The campaign needs to switch gears if it hopes to attract younger voters.
idioms.example_zh: 若想吸引更年轻的选民，这场竞选活动需要转变策略。

collocations.example_en: In the exercise, managers and employees were asked to switch roles for a day.
collocations.example_zh: 在这次演练中，管理层和员工被要求互换一天的角色。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 微弱优势击败；挤掉（竞争对手）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The incumbent mayor edged out her rival by fewer than two hundred votes.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 现任市长以不到两百票的微弱优势险胜对手。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （价格、数字等）小幅上涨/小幅下跌
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Oil prices edged up slightly following reports of supply disruptions.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在供应中断的报道传出后，石油价格小幅上涨。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 悄悄挪开；缓慢退缩
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Sensing trouble, he quietly edged away from the confrontation.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 察觉到不妙，他悄悄退离了冲突现场。

collocations.example_en: Scientists warn that global temperatures are edging closer to the critical threshold.
collocations.example_zh: 科学家警告称，全球气温正逐步逼近临界阈值。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 倾泻而下；（批评、责难或物品）大量落在……上
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Bombs and shrapnel rained down on the besieged city.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 炸弹和弹片倾泻在这座被围困的城市上。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （赛事、活动等因下雨）取消或延期
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The championship cricket match was rained off in the afternoon.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 板球冠军赛因下午下雨而被迫取消。

idioms.meaning: 煞风景；泼冷水
idioms.example_en: I hate to rain on your parade, but the budget hasn't been approved yet.
idioms.example_zh: 我真不想泼你冷水，但预算其实还没有获批。

idioms.meaning: 祸不单行；倒霉事接踵而至
idioms.example_en: First my laptop crashed, and now my car won't start—when it rains, it pours.
idioms.example_zh: 先是笔记本电脑崩溃，现在车又打不着火了——真是祸不单行。

collocations.example_en: It was raining cats and dogs, so we had to abandon our hiking plans.
collocations.example_zh: 外面下着倾盆大雨，我们不得不放弃徒步计划。

collocations.meaning: 对某人拳脚相加；劈头盖脸地辱骂某人
collocations.example_en: The angry mob began to rain blows upon the captured suspect.
collocations.example_zh: 愤怒的人群开始对着被抓获的嫌疑人拳打脚踢。

collocations.example_en: The sudden rise in raw material costs completely negatived the effect of our tax cuts.
collocations.example_zh: 原材料成本的骤增完全抵消了我们减税带来的效果。

collocations.example_en: The committee voted decisively to negative the controversial motion.
collocations.example_zh: 委员会果断投票否决了这项颇具争议的动议。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 近似；濒于；简直就是（某种极端情绪或状态）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: His obsessive behavior borders on madness.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他偏执的行为几乎近乎疯狂。

collocations.example_en: The demands made by the union border on the absurd.
collocations.example_zh: 工会提出的要求近乎荒唐可笑。

collocations.example_en: The estate is bordered by dense pine forests on two sides.
collocations.example_zh: 庄园的两侧被茂密的松树林环绕。

idioms.meaning: 忍不住/禁不住做某事
idioms.example_en: I simply couldn't resist buying that vintage leather jacket.
idioms.example_zh: 我实在忍不住买下了那件复古皮夹克。

collocations.example_en: It takes tremendous willpower to resist temptation when you are on a strict diet.
collocations.example_zh: 在严格节食期间，抵制诱惑需要极大的毅力。

collocations.example_en: The suspect attempted to flee the scene and actively resisted arrest.
collocations.example_zh: 嫌疑人企图逃离现场并暴力拒捕。

collocations.example_en: She had to resist the urge to check her phone during the interview.
collocations.example_zh: 她在面试期间不得不克制看手机的冲动。

idioms.meaning: 捣乱；兴风作浪；打破现存稳定局面
idioms.example_en: Nobody wants to rock the boat right before the major product launch.
idioms.example_zh: 没人想在重大产品发布前节外生枝。

idioms.meaning: 错失良机
idioms.example_en: If you don't invest in tech stocks now, you might miss the boat entirely.
idioms.example_zh: 如果你现在不投资科技股，可能会彻底错失良机。

collocations.meaning: 乘船顺流而下/乘船横渡
collocations.example_en: We spent the afternoon boating down the tranquil river.
collocations.example_zh: 我们花了一个下午乘船顺着宁静的河流而下。

idioms.meaning: 即兴发挥；临时应付；见机行事
idioms.example_en: I hadn't prepared a speech, so I just had to step up and wing it.
idioms.example_zh: 我没准备讲稿，只能硬着头皮上台即兴发挥。

idioms.meaning: 展翅飞向；疾速奔向
idioms.example_en: The migrating geese winged their way southward across the autumn sky.
idioms.example_zh: 南迁的大雁展翅划过秋日的天空，一路向南。

collocations.meaning: 击伤某人的手臂/侧翼；擦伤
collocations.example_en: The sniper managed to wing the suspect in the shoulder before he could shoot.
collocations.example_zh: 狙击手在嫌犯开枪前击伤了他的肩膀。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 大幅抬高（价格、费用）；用千斤顶顶起
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Hotels routinely jack up their prices during the peak tourist season.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在旅游旺季，酒店通常会大幅抬高价格。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （非正式）放弃，辞掉（工作或学业）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He decided to jack in his corporate job and travel the world.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他决定辞去大公司的工作，环游世界。

collocations.example_en: Make sure the handbrake is on before you jack up the car to change the tire.
collocations.example_zh: 用千斤顶顶起汽车换胎之前，务必确保拉好手刹。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （在讨论中）回头再议；稍后跟进
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Let's table that agenda item for now and circle back to it tomorrow.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我们先把那个议题搁置一下，明天再回头讨论。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 在……周围盘旋；绕着……打转；拐弯抹角回避核心
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The vultures were circling around the carcass in the desert.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 秃鹰在沙漠中的动物尸体上方盘旋。

idioms.meaning: 固守阵地严阵以待；结成联盟团结自卫
idioms.example_en: Facing intense scrutiny from the press, the cabinet circled the wagons.
idioms.example_zh: 面对媒体的严苛质询，内阁成员结成统一战线严阵以待。

collocations.example_en: A police helicopter circled overhead throughout the protest.
collocations.example_zh: 抗议期间，一架警用直升机一直在头顶盘旋。

collocations.example_en: I circled the date of the concert on my calendar months in advance.
collocations.example_zh: 我提前好几个月在日历上圈出了音乐会的日期。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 出租（设备、车辆）；受雇于人做临时工
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The company hires out heavy machinery for construction projects.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 该公司为建筑工程提供重型机械租赁服务。

idioms.meaning: 随意任免员工；握有人事大权
idioms.example_en: The ruthless CEO is notorious for his hire-and-fire approach to management.
idioms.example_zh: 这位铁腕CEO以其频繁任免员工的管理风格而闻名。

collocations.example_en: We hired a car at the airport to tour the Scottish Highlands.
collocations.example_zh: 我们在机场租了一辆车，去苏格兰高地游览。

collocations.example_en: Tech firms are competing fiercely to hire qualified engineering personnel.
collocations.example_zh: 科技公司正激烈竞争以招聘合格的工程技术人员。

idioms.meaning: 想尽一切办法；穷尽一切途径
idioms.example_en: Investigators promised to explore every avenue to find the missing child.
idioms.example_zh: 调查人员承诺将穷尽一切途径寻找失踪的儿童。

collocations.example_en: The board met yesterday to explore strategic options for future growth.
collocations.example_zh: 董事会昨天召开会议，探讨未来增长的战略性选择。

collocations.phrase: explore an issue / topic in depth
collocations.meaning: 深入探讨某一议题/课题
collocations.example_en: Her doctoral dissertation explores this cultural issue in depth.
collocations.example_zh: 她的博士论文深入探讨了这一文化议题。

collocations.example_en: With the rise of generative AI, scientists are exploring uncharted territory.
collocations.example_zh: 随着生成式AI的兴起，科学家们正在探索未知的新领域。

collocations.meaning: 考虑或抱有某种想法；怀有某种观念
collocations.example_en: The board refused to entertain the idea of selling the company.
collocations.example_zh: 董事会拒绝考虑出售公司的想法。

collocations.example_en: The firm spends thousands of dollars every year entertaining corporate clients.
collocations.example_zh: 这家公司每年花费数千美元招待企业客户。

collocations.example_en: He still entertained lingering doubts about her true motives.
collocations.example_zh: 他对她的真实动机依然心存疑虑。

collocations.example_en: Standing at the top of the hill, she surveyed the landscape below.
collocations.example_zh: 她站在山顶上，俯瞰着脚下的全景。

collocations.example_en: Researchers surveyed public opinion on the proposed tax reforms.
collocations.example_zh: 研究人员就拟议的税制改革进行了民意调查。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 从…逃脱；摆脱（束缚或困境）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Two convicts managed to escape from the high-security prison.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 两名罪犯设法从高度戒备的监狱中逃脱了。

idioms.meaning: 被某人忽略；未被某人注意到
idioms.example_en: The subtle change in the contract somehow escaped the lawyer's notice.
idioms.example_zh: 合同中这一细微的变动不知怎么竟被律师忽略了。

collocations.meaning: 毫发无损地逃脱；幸免于难
collocations.example_en: Miraculously, all passengers escaped unhurt from the wreckage.
collocations.example_zh: 奇迹般地，所有乘客都从残骸中毫发无损地幸免于难。

collocations.example_en: Many young people turn to video games to escape reality.
collocations.example_zh: 很多年轻人借由电子游戏来逃避现实。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 背离；从…转移或转变开来
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Consumer preferences have shifted away from sugary drinks toward healthier options.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 消费者的偏好已经从含糖饮料转向了更健康的选择。

idioms.meaning: 换挡；改变步调；转变话题或方法
idioms.example_en: Let's shift gears and look at the marketing strategy for the next quarter.
idioms.example_zh: 我们换个思路，来看看下个季度的营销策略。

collocations.example_en: The manager tried to shift the blame onto his subordinates when the project failed.
collocations.example_zh: 项目失败后，经理试图把责任推给下属。

collocations.example_en: The campaign has shifted its focus to suburban voters.
collocations.example_zh: 该竞选活动已将重点转向郊区选民。

collocations.meaning: 写博客讨论某事；在博客上记录
collocations.example_en: She regularly blogs about sustainable fashion and minimalism.
collocations.example_zh: 她经常写博客分享可持续时尚与极简主义生活。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 聚集在…周围；围拢
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Eager fans crowded around the stage door hoping to catch a glimpse of the singer.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 热切的歌迷聚集在舞台门周围，希望能看一眼那位歌手。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 涌入；挤进
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Over fifty thousand spectators crowded into the stadium.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 超过五万名观众涌入了体育场。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 排挤；挤走；挤占
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Large supermarket chains are crowding out small independent grocery stores.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 大型连锁超市正在挤压小型独立杂货店的生存空间。

collocations.example_en: Fond childhood memories crowded her mind as she walked through her hometown.
collocations.example_zh: 走在家乡的路上，美好的童年记忆涌上了她的心头。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 用刨子刨平；刨去（多余木料）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The carpenter planed down the edge of the door so it would shut properly.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 木匠把门边刨薄了一点，这样门就能关严实了。

collocations.example_en: He planed the rough timber smooth before applying the varnish.
collocations.example_zh: 他在刷清漆之前把粗糙的木料刨平整了。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 喋喋不休；叽叽喳喳说个不停
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The children twittered away excitedly in the back of the car all through the journey.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 孩子们在车后座上兴奋地叽叽喳喳说了一路。

collocations.meaning: 鸟鸣啁啾；鸟儿叽叽喳喳叫
collocations.example_en: We were woken early by the sound of birds twittering outside the bedroom window.
collocations.example_zh: 清晨，卧室窗外清脆的鸟鸣声把我们唤醒了。

collocations.example_en: The judge sentenced the convicted criminal to life imprisonment without parole.
collocations.example_zh: 法官判处该罪犯终身监禁，不得假释。

collocations.example_en: Instead of jail time, the first-time offender was sentenced to 120 hours of community service.
collocations.example_zh: 这名初犯没有被判入狱，而是被判处120小时的社区服务。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 穿上专业服装/队服；准备上场行动
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The players are already in the locker room suiting up for the championship game.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 队员们已经在更衣室换上球衣，准备迎接冠军赛。

idioms.meaning: 随你的便；由你高兴（常带轻微不耐烦语气）
idioms.example_en: If you don't want to come to the cinema with us, suit yourself.
idioms.example_zh: 如果你不想和我们一起去电影院，那就随你便吧。

idioms.meaning: 跟着做；效仿
idioms.example_en: When one major airline lowered its baggage fees, competitors quickly followed suit.
idioms.example_zh: 当一家主要航空公司降低行李费时，竞争对手们也迅速效仿。

collocations.example_en: We can tailor the training program to suit the specific needs of your company.
collocations.example_zh: 我们可以定制培训方案，以契合贵公司的具体需求。

collocations.phrase: suit someone down to the ground
collocations.meaning: 完全适合某人；再合适不过
collocations.example_en: Working remotely suits her down to the ground because of her family commitments.
collocations.example_zh: 因为要照顾家庭，远程办公对她来说再合适不过了。

collocations.example_en: Regular audits are conducted to ensure strict compliance with federal regulations.
collocations.example_zh: 定期进行审计以确保严格遵守联邦法规。

collocations.example_en: The management must take immediate steps to ensure this never happens again.
collocations.example_zh: 管理层必须立即采取措施，确保此类事件不再发生。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 抱怨；发牢骚
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He spent the entire evening bitching about his boss.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他整个晚上都在抱怨他的老板。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （因害怕而）临阵退缩；狠狠斥责
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He promised to skydive with us, but bitched out at the last minute.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他原本答应和我们一起跳伞，但最后一刻却认怂退缩了。

collocations.example_en: Stop bitching and moaning and do something about the problem.
collocations.example_zh: 别再怨天尤人了，赶紧采取行动解决问题。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 对……颐指气使；对……发号施令
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Stop trying to boss me around—you're not my supervisor.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 别老想对我发号施令，你又不是我的主管。

collocations.example_en: You must obtain written permission before reproducing any part of this document.
collocations.example_zh: 在复制本文档的任何部分之前，必须获得书面许可。

collocations.example_en: Researchers obtained valuable data from the long-term clinical trial.
collocations.example_zh: 研究人员从这项长期临床试验中获取了宝贵的数据。

idioms.meaning: 差强人意；大有改进余地
idioms.example_en: The quality of customer service leaves much to be desired.
idioms.example_zh: 客户服务的质量差强人意，有很大改进余地。

collocations.example_en: She expressed a strong desire to return to her hometown.
collocations.example_zh: 她表达了重返故乡的强烈渴望。

collocations.example_en: Both nations earnestly desire a peaceful resolution to the conflict.
collocations.example_zh: 两国都殷切期盼和平解决这场冲突。

collocations.example_en: The judge instructed the jury to disregard the witness's last statement.
collocations.example_zh: 法官指示陪审团忽略证人的最后陈述。

collocations.meaning: 向某人传授/教授某项技能或知识
collocations.example_en: She was employed to instruct senior executives in advanced negotiation tactics.
collocations.example_zh: 她受聘向高管传授高级谈判策略。

collocations.example_en: The sale of the subsidiary netted a profit of over two million dollars.
collocations.example_zh: 出售该子公司带来了超过两百万美元的净利润。

collocations.meaning: 成功赢得合同/促成交易
collocations.example_en: Her impressive presentation netted the company a lucrative government contract.
collocations.example_zh: 她出色的演示为公司赢得了一份利润丰厚的政府合同。

idioms.meaning: 见证；证明
idioms.example_en: The crumbling ruins bear witness to the ancient city's former glory.
idioms.example_zh: 断壁残垣见证了这座古城昔日的辉煌。

collocations.example_en: Volunteers witnessed firsthand the devastating effects of the drought.
collocations.example_zh: 志愿者们亲眼目睹了干旱带来的毁灭性影响。

collocations.meaning: 见证/经历剧变或大幅增长
collocations.example_en: The tech sector has witnessed a dramatic surge in artificial intelligence investments.
collocations.example_zh: 科技领域见证了人工智能投资的迅猛激增。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （声音、话语）逐渐变弱；渐趋无声
phrasal_verbs.example_en: His voice trailed off as he realized nobody was listening.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 意识到没人听后，他的声音渐渐小了下去。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 落在后面；处于落后地位
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The local manufacturer continues to trail behind its overseas competitors in innovation.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 该本土制造商在创新方面仍落后于海外竞争对手。

idioms.meaning: 开辟道路；开创新天地
idioms.example_en: She blazed a trail for women in corporate finance.
idioms.example_zh: 她为女性进军企业金融界开辟了道路。

collocations.example_en: The incumbent senator is currently trailing in the polls ahead of the election.
collocations.example_zh: 在选前民调中，现任参议员目前处于落后状态。

idioms.meaning: 在翻译/转述中失真；意思未被传达
idioms.example_en: Much of the cultural nuance was unfortunately lost in translation.
idioms.example_zh: 不幸的是，许多文化层面的细腻寓意在翻译过程中遗失了。

collocations.example_en: We hope that higher consumer confidence will soon translate into increased retail spending.
collocations.example_zh: 我们希望消费者信心的提升能尽快转化为零售支出的增长。

collocations.example_en: The novel has been translated from Russian into more than thirty languages.
collocations.example_zh: 这部小说已从俄语翻译成了三十多种语言。

collocations.example_en: The committee needs to examine the proposal closely before making a final decision.
collocations.example_zh: 委员会在做出最终决定前需要仔细审视该提案。

collocations.example_en: Forensic experts were called in to examine the evidence collected from the scene.
collocations.example_zh: 法医专家被召集来审查从现场收集的证据。

collocations.example_en: The doctor examined the patient and found no signs of infection.
collocations.example_zh: 医生给病人做了检查，没有发现感染迹象。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 与……建立牢固的情感纽带；与……亲近
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Mothers are encouraged to spend time holding their newborns to bond with them.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 人们鼓励母亲多抱抱新生儿，以与他们建立情感联系。

collocations.meaning: 在情感上紧密结合；产生情感共鸣
collocations.example_en: The shared traumatic experience helped the team members bond emotionally.
collocations.example_zh: 共同经历的艰难险阻让队员们在情感上紧密团结在一起。

collocations.example_en: The adhesive chemically bonds the two plastic surfaces together.
collocations.example_zh: 这种粘合剂通过化学作用将两个塑料表面牢固粘接在一起。

collocations.example_en: Tourists love to sample the local cuisine at the night market.
collocations.example_zh: 游客们喜欢在夜市品尝当地的风味美食。

collocations.example_en: The pollsters sampled voters from across the country to predict the election outcome.
collocations.example_zh: 民调人员在全国范围内对选民进行抽样调查，以预测选举结果。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 批量寄出；邮寄分发
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The company mailed out thousands of brochures to prospective clients.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 公司向潜在客户邮寄了数千份宣传手册。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 邮寄提交（选票、申请等）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Voters can mail in their ballots if they cannot visit polling stations.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 无法前往投票站的选民可以通过邮寄方式提交选票。

collocations.example_en: I need to stop by the post office to mail a package to my parents.
collocations.example_zh: 我得去一趟邮局，给我父母寄个包裹。

collocations.meaning: 贯彻/实施政策、计划或战略
collocations.example_en: The government has struggled to implement the new environmental policy effectively.
collocations.example_zh: 政府一直难以有效推行这项新的环保政策。

collocations.example_en: The new manager plans to implement sweeping reforms across all departments.
collocations.example_zh: 新经理计划在所有部门大刀阔斧地推行改革。

collocations.example_en: It will take at least two years to fully implement the security upgrades.
collocations.example_zh: 全面实施这些安全升级至少需要两年时间。

collocations.meaning: 提供背景信息；阐明背景情况
collocations.example_en: The documentary backgrounds the conflict with rare archival footage.
collocations.example_zh: 这部纪录片借助珍贵的档案影像介绍了该冲突的历史背景。

idioms.meaning: 赢得某人的芳心；俘获某人的心
idioms.example_en: With his gentle humor and kindness, he quickly captured her heart.
idioms.example_zh: 凭借温柔的风趣与善良，他很快赢得了她的芳心。

collocations.meaning: 激发……的想象力；引起广泛关注
collocations.example_en: The space mission captured the imagination of millions around the globe.
collocations.example_zh: 这项太空探索任务激发了全球数百万人的无限遐想。

collocations.meaning: 抓住……的精髓；生动刻画出
collocations.example_en: The portrait captures the essence of her youthful energy.
collocations.example_zh: 这幅肖像画抓住了她身上那股青春活力的精髓。

collocations.example_en: The startup launched aggressive promotions to capture market share from established brands.
collocations.example_zh: 这家初创公司发起了猛烈的促销攻势，以从老牌品牌手中抢占市场份额。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 深思；反省；回忆
phrasal_verbs.example_en: She sat quietly, reflecting on the mistakes she had made during the negotiations.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 她静静地坐着，反思自己在谈判中所犯的错误。

collocations.example_en: The survey results accurately reflect current consumer trends.
collocations.example_zh: 调查结果准确反映了当前的消费者趋势。

collocations.example_en: These numbers do not accurately reflect the real economic growth.
collocations.example_zh: 这些数据并没有准确反映真实的经济增长情况。

collocations.example_en: The economic crisis helped birth a nationwide labor rights movement.
collocations.example_zh: 这场经济危机催生了一场全国性的劳工权益运动。

collocations.example_en: Late-night brainstorming sessions eventually birthed a revolutionary product concept.
collocations.example_zh: 深夜的头脑风暴最终孕育出了一个革命性的产品概念。

collocations.example_en: The chef demonstrated how to joint a whole chicken with a sharp knife.
collocations.example_zh: 主厨现场示范了如何用一把锋利的刀将整只鸡按骨关节剔分切块。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 撞倒；使极其惊讶/倾倒
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I was completely bowled over by her extraordinary talent.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我完全被她非凡的才华折服了。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （板球中）击中三柱门淘汰击球手；击败
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The fast bowler bowled out their best batsman in the opening over.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 这名快速投球手在第一轮就将对方的最佳击球手淘汰出局。

collocations.example_en: The vintage sports car bowled along the coastal road.
collocations.example_zh: 那辆老式跑车在沿海公路上轻快地疾驰。

collocations.example_en: She bowled a strike in the final frame to win the tournament.
collocations.example_zh: 她在最后一局打出了全中，赢得了比赛。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 属于；是……的成员；应归入
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The rare antique once belonged to the royal family.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 这件珍稀古董曾属于王室。

collocations.meaning: 天生一对；应归在同一类别
collocations.example_en: Those two have been inseparable for years—they simply belong together.
collocations.example_zh: 他们俩多年来形影不离，简直是天造地设的一对。

collocations.example_en: It took several months for the new exchange student to feel like she belonged.
collocations.example_zh: 那名新交换生花了几个月才真正有了归属感。

collocations.example_en: His temples were beginning to silver with age.
collocations.example_zh: 他的两鬓随着岁月流逝开始泛白。

collocations.example_en: Artisans used a traditional chemical process to silver the glass mirrors.
collocations.example_zh: 工匠们采用传统的化学工艺给玻璃镜镀银。

collocations.meaning: 聘请律师；支付律师代理费
collocations.example_en: The defendant lacked the financial resources to fee a prominent lawyer.
collocations.example_zh: 被告没有足够的经济实力聘请知名律师。

collocations.meaning: 展现出对……的坚定承诺/投入
collocations.example_en: The university demonstrates a strong commitment to environmental sustainability.
collocations.example_zh: 该大学展现出对环境可持续发展的坚定承诺。

collocations.example_en: The latest clinical trials demonstrate conclusively that the vaccine is safe.
collocations.example_zh: 最新的临床试验证据确凿地表明该疫苗是安全的。

collocations.example_en: Thousands of workers took to the streets to demonstrate against the proposed pension reform.
collocations.example_zh: 数千名工人走上街头示威，抗议拟议的养老金改革。

collocations.example_en: The entire exhibition was themed around renewable energy solutions.
collocations.example_zh: 整个展览都是以可再生能源解决方案为主题的。

collocations.meaning: 为活动/餐厅确定特定主题风格
collocations.example_en: They decided to theme the charity gala as a 1920s masquerade ball.
collocations.example_zh: 他们决定将慈善晚会的主题定为20世纪20年代风格的假面舞会。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 将……改造/转变为……
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The developer converted the abandoned warehouse into luxury apartments.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 开发商把废弃的仓库改建成了高档公寓。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 改信（宗教）；皈依；转用（新系统或方法）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The company converted to cloud computing to streamline its workflow.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 该公司转向使用云计算以简化其工作流程。

idioms.meaning: 向本就赞同的人说教；白费唇舌劝说已知者
idioms.example_en: Advocating green policies at an eco-summit is simply preaching to the converted.
idioms.example_zh: 在生态峰会上倡导环保政策，无异于向信徒布道，毫无必要。

collocations.example_en: You can convert your local currency at the airport bank counter.
collocations.example_zh: 你可以在机场的银行柜台兑换当地货币。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 加满油；补充燃料（或能量）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Let's fuel up the rental car before we hit the highway.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 上高速公路前我们先把租来的车加满油吧。

collocations.example_en: The CEO's sudden absence fueled speculation about an imminent takeover.
collocations.example_zh: 首席执行官的突然缺席引发了关于公司即将被收购的猜测。

collocations.meaning: 刺激经济增长；推高通货膨胀
collocations.example_en: Surging energy prices continue to fuel inflation across the eurozone.
collocations.example_zh: 飙升的能源价格继续推高整个欧元区的通货膨胀。

idioms.meaning: 严厉斥责/批评某人
idioms.example_en: The committee took the minister to task over the mishandling of public funds.
idioms.example_zh: 委员会因公款处理不当对部长提出了严厉批评。

collocations.example_en: A specialized unit was tasked with investigating the cyberattack.
collocations.example_zh: 一个专门小组受命调查这起网络攻击事件。

collocations.phrase: task a team / committee to do sth
collocations.meaning: 指派团队/委员会执行某任务
collocations.example_en: The mayor tasked an independent panel to draft the housing guidelines.
collocations.example_zh: 市长指派了一个独立专家组来起草住房指南。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 丢弃；摆脱；摒弃
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He cast aside his initial doubts and decided to accept the challenge.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他抛开了最初的疑虑，决定接受这一挑战。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 解开缆绳启航；摆脱（束缚或困扰）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The crew cast off at dawn and sailed into the open ocean.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 船员们在黎明时分解缆启航，驶向浩瀚的大洋。

idioms.meaning: 明珠暗投；对牛弹琴
idioms.example_en: Explaining fine wine to him is like casting pearls before swine.
idioms.example_zh: 跟他讲名酒的品味简直是对牛弹琴。

collocations.example_en: The discovery of fresh evidence cast serious doubt on the witness's testimony.
collocations.example_zh: 新证据的发现使证人的证词遭到了严重质疑。

collocations.example_en: Millions of registered voters turned out to cast their ballots yesterday.
collocations.example_zh: 昨天数百万注册选民前往投票站投下了选票。

collocations.example_en: Archaeologists hope the newly excavated artifacts will cast light on ancient trade routes.
collocations.example_zh: 考古学家希望新出土的文物能揭示古代贸易路线的奥秘。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 仿照；以……为蓝本
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The new legal framework was patterned after the German system.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 新的法律框架是仿照德国体制构建的。

collocations.phrase: pattern oneself on / pattern oneself after
collocations.meaning: 以……为榜样；模仿某人的行为举止
collocations.example_en: As a young journalist, he patterned himself on his mentor.
collocations.example_zh: 青年时期作为记者，他一直以自己的导师为榜样。

collocations.meaning: 具有复杂的花纹或图案
collocations.example_en: The ceiling was intricately patterned with gold leaf and floral motifs.
collocations.example_zh: 天花板上饰有由金箔和花卉图案交织而成的繁复花纹。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 与……交流/互动；与……相互作用
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The drug may interact with other medications, causing side effects.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 该药物可能会与其他药物发生相互作用，从而引起副作用。

collocations.example_en: The software allows customers to interact directly with support agents.
collocations.example_zh: 该软件使客户能够直接与客服人员互动。

collocations.example_en: Children need opportunities to interact socially with their peers.
collocations.example_zh: 孩子们需要有机会与同龄人进行社交互动。

collocations.phrase: sky a ball / sky a shot
collocations.meaning: （在足球、板球、高尔夫等运动中）把球打飞；把球高高踢入空中
collocations.example_en: He had an open goal but managed to sky the ball over the crossbar.
collocations.example_zh: 他面对空门，却把球一脚踢飞，高高跃过了横梁。

collocations.example_en: She occupied herself with solving crossword puzzles to pass the time.
collocations.example_zh: 她忙着做填字游戏以打发时间。

collocations.phrase: occupy a position / occupy a role
collocations.example_en: He currently occupies a senior position in the Ministry of Finance.
collocations.example_zh: 他目前在财政部担任高级职务。

collocations.phrase: occupy one's thoughts / occupy one's mind
collocations.example_en: Concerns about the upcoming audit occupied his mind all weekend.
collocations.example_zh: 对即将到来的审计的担忧整个周末都占据着他的思绪。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 搞砸；弄脏；把……弄得一团糟
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I was nervous during the interview and completely messed up the technical questions.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我面试时很紧张，把专业问题答得一团糟。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 瞎摆弄；招惹，惹恼
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Don't mess with the thermostat; the heating system is quite sensitive.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 别乱动温控器，供暖系统非常敏感。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 虚度光阴，无所事事；胡闹，瞎搞
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Stop messing around and get back to work before the boss notices.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 别胡闹了，趁老板还没发现赶紧回去工作。

idioms.meaning: 扰乱某人的心智；使某人感到困惑或精神崩溃
idioms.example_en: His mixed signals are really messing with my head.
idioms.example_zh: 他那些忽冷忽热的信号真把我搞糊涂了。

collocations.example_en: You can download the latest updates directly from our official website onto your device.
collocations.example_zh: 您可以直接从我们的官方网站将最新更新下载到您的设备上。

collocations.example_en: The network went down because several users were downloading massive video files simultaneously.
collocations.example_zh: 由于多名用户同时下载海量视频文件，网络瘫痪了。

collocations.example_en: Universities strictly monitor networks to prevent students from illegally downloading copyrighted material.
collocations.example_zh: 大学严密监控网络，以防止学生非法下载受版权保护的内容。

collocations.example_en: The proposed tax reforms are being fiercely debated in parliament.
collocations.example_zh: 拟议的税收改革正在议会中受到激烈辩论。

collocations.example_en: The committee is still debating whether to approve the construction project.
collocations.example_zh: 委员会仍在权衡是否批准该建设项目。

collocations.example_en: Economists have long debated the merits of free trade versus protectionism.
collocations.example_zh: 经济学家长期以来一直在争论自由贸易与贸易保护主义的利弊。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 用卡车运进 / 运出
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Drinking water had to be trucked into the disaster zone after the pipelines ruptured.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 管道破裂后，饮用水不得不通过卡车运进灾区。

idioms.meaning: 拒绝与……有任何瓜葛；对……不予理睬
idioms.example_en: The strict editor would have no truck with sloppy research or unsubstantiated claims.
idioms.example_zh: 这位严谨的编辑绝不容忍粗疏的研究或缺乏依据的主张。

idioms.meaning: 坚持不懈；继续前行（非正式口语）
idioms.example_en: Times are tough right now, but all we can do is keep on trucking.
idioms.example_zh: 眼下时局艰难，但我们唯一能做的就是坚持熬下去。

collocations.phrase: constitute a threat / constitute a danger
collocations.example_en: The rising cyberattacks constitute a severe threat to national infrastructure.
collocations.example_zh: 日益增多的网络攻击对国家基础设施构成了严重威胁。

collocations.phrase: constitute a breach / constitute a violation
collocations.meaning: 构成违约；构成违法/违规
collocations.example_en: Failing to disclose this conflict of interest constitutes a clear breach of company policy.
collocations.example_zh: 未能披露此利益冲突构成了对公司政策的明显违反。

collocations.example_en: Female students now constitute a majority of the medical school enrollment.
collocations.example_zh: 女学生目前在该医学院的注册人数中占大多数。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 建议不要；规劝反对
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Most financial experts advise against taking on high-interest consumer debt.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 多数金融专家建议不要背负高利息的消费类债务。

collocations.example_en: We strongly advise passengers to check their flight status before heading to the airport.
collocations.example_zh: 我们强烈建议旅客在前往机场前确认航班动态。

collocations.phrase: advise sb on / advise sb about
collocations.meaning: 就……向某人提供专业建议
collocations.example_en: She was hired to advise the board on digital transformation strategies.
collocations.example_zh: 她受聘就数字化转型战略向董事会提供专业咨询。

collocations.meaning: 随时向某人通报最新情况
collocations.example_en: Please keep me advised of any new developments regarding the merger.
collocations.example_zh: 关于合并的任何新进展，请随时向我通报。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 回信；给某人答复
phrasal_verbs.example_en: I sent an email last week, but she hasn't replied back yet.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 我上周发了邮件，但她还没回复。

collocations.example_en: Thank you for replying so promptly to our inquiry.
collocations.example_zh: 感谢您如此迅速地回复我们的垂询。

collocations.example_en: When asked if he would accept the offer, he replied in the affirmative.
collocations.example_zh: 当被问及是否接受该提议时，他给出了肯定的答复。

collocations.meaning: 在（某地区/山坡）植树造林
collocations.example_en: The government launched a project to forest the barren hillsides to prevent erosion.
collocations.example_zh: 政府启动了一项在荒山坡上植树造林的工程，以防止水土流失。

collocations.meaning: 身边围绕着…；结交…（类型的人）
collocations.example_en: Great leaders often surround themselves with talented and critical thinkers.
collocations.example_zh: 伟大的领导者往往会在身边聚集才华横溢且具备批判性思维的人才。

collocations.example_en: The peaceful cottage was completely surrounded by towering pine trees.
collocations.example_zh: 这座宁静的小屋完全被高耸的松树所环抱。

collocations.example_en: Professor Miller was invited to chair the annual symposium.
collocations.example_zh: 米勒教授受邀主持本届年度研讨会。

collocations.meaning: 担任委员会/专家评审组主席
collocations.example_en: She was chosen to chair the ethics committee due to her extensive legal experience.
collocations.example_zh: 凭借丰富的法律经验，她被选为该伦理委员会的主席。

collocations.meaning: 出国度假（主要用于英式英语）
collocations.example_en: Fewer families are choosing to holiday abroad this summer due to rising travel costs.
collocations.example_zh: 由于旅行成本上涨，今年夏天选择出国度假的家庭变少了。

collocations.meaning: 在…度假（主要用于英式英语）
collocations.example_en: They usually holiday in the south of France every August.
collocations.example_zh: 他们通常每年八月去法国南部度假。

idioms.meaning: 对（坏事）负有责任；应受责备
idioms.example_en: Faulty wiring was to blame for the fire that destroyed the warehouse.
idioms.example_zh: 电线老化是导致仓库大火的罪魁祸首。

collocations.meaning: 因某事责怪/归咎于某人
collocations.example_en: You can't blame him for feeling disappointed after all that effort.
collocations.example_zh: 付出了那么多努力后，你不能怪他感到失望。

collocations.meaning: 把某事归咎于/推卸给某人或某事
collocations.example_en: Officials blamed the delay on severe weather conditions.
collocations.example_zh: 官员将延误归咎于恶劣的天气条件。

collocations.meaning: 很难责怪某人；完全能够理解某人的做法
collocations.example_en: With prices soaring like this, you can hardly blame consumers for cutting back.
collocations.example_zh: 物价这样飙升，你完全不能怪消费者削减开支。

collocations.example_en: Independent researchers were hired to assess the environmental impact of the dam.
collocations.example_zh: 独立研究人员受雇对大坝的环境影响进行评估。

collocations.example_en: Insurance adjusters visited the site immediately to assess the damage.
collocations.example_zh: 保险理赔员立即赶赴现场评估损失情况。

collocations.example_en: It is difficult to objectively assess a candidate's potential in a thirty-minute interview.
collocations.example_zh: 很难在三十分钟的面试中客观评估一名求职者的潜力。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （使）安静下来；平息；（活动等）放缓
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The teacher waited patiently for the class to quiet down before starting the lecture.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 老师耐心地等待全班安静下来后才开始讲课。

collocations.example_en: The doctor's reassuring words helped to quiet her growing fears.
collocations.example_zh: 医生宽慰的话语有助于平息她日益加剧的恐惧。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: （航天器、火箭等）离地升空
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The rocket lifted off successfully from the launch pad at dawn.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 火箭于黎明时分从发射台成功升空。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 举起；使振作/鼓舞（精神）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Her encouraging message really lifted him up when he was feeling down.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 在他情绪低落时，她鼓励的话语确实让他振作了起来。

idioms.meaning: 袖手旁观；一点忙都不帮
idioms.example_en: He just sat on the couch and didn't lift a finger while we cleaned the house.
idioms.example_zh: 我们打扫屋子时，他光坐在沙发上，一点忙都不帮。

collocations.example_en: The government announced plans to lift travel restrictions by next month.
collocations.example_zh: 政府宣布计划在下个月前解除旅行限制。

collocations.meaning: 振奋某人的精神；使心情好转
collocations.example_en: A walk in the fresh morning air always helps lift my spirits.
collocations.example_zh: 在清晨清新的空气中散步总能让我精神一振。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 阿谀奉承；巴结；拍马屁
phrasal_verbs.example_en: He spent the entire meeting kissing up to the new manager to secure a promotion.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他整个会议都在拍新经理的马屁，以谋求晋升。

idioms.meaning: 与…永别；做好彻底失去某物的心理准备
idioms.example_en: If you miss the filing deadline, you can kiss your tax refund goodbye.
idioms.example_zh: 如果你错过了申报截止日期，你的退税款就泡汤了。

collocations.meaning: 轻吻某人道别/轻吻道晚安
collocations.example_en: She kissed her daughter goodnight and turned off the bedroom light.
collocations.example_zh: 她吻了吻女儿道了声晚安，随后关掉了卧室的灯。

collocations.example_en: He greeted her with a warm smile and kissed her lightly on the cheek.
collocations.example_zh: 他带着温暖的微笑迎向她，并在她的脸颊上轻轻吻了一下。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 与……冲突；与……抵触/不一致
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The results of the new study directly conflict with previous findings.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 这项新研究的结果与先前的发现直接冲突。

collocations.example_en: His personal interests conflict sharply with his public duties.
collocations.example_zh: 他的个人利益与公职职责截然冲突。

collocations.example_en: Family members often conflict over inheritance matters.
collocations.example_zh: 家庭成员常因遗产问题发生争执。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 翻耕；翻松（土壤）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: They spent the weekend tilling up the garden to plant vegetables.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 他们周末翻耕了花园准备种植蔬菜。

collocations.example_en: Generations of farmers have tilled this land with great care.
collocations.example_zh: 世世代代的农民都在悉心耕作这片土地。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 把……和……混淆/弄混
phrasal_verbs.example_en: People often confuse being busy with being productive.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 人们常常把瞎忙和高效混为一谈。

collocations.meaning: 混淆视听；使问题复杂化
collocations.example_en: Introducing irrelevant statistics will only confuse the issue further.
collocations.example_zh: 引入无关的统计数据只会让问题更加扑朔迷离。

collocations.example_en: The twin sisters look so similar that they easily confuse their teachers.
collocations.example_zh: 这对双胞胎姐妹长得太像了，经常让老师分不清。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 屈服于；顺从；接受（审查或裁决）
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The suspects agreed to submit to questioning without a lawyer present.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 嫌疑人同意在没有律师在场的情况下接受讯问。

collocations.example_en: All candidates must submit an application before the end of the month.
collocations.example_zh: 所有候选人必须在月底前提交申请。

collocations.example_en: Students are required to submit their final thesis by Friday afternoon.
collocations.example_zh: 学生被要求在周五下午前提交最终论文。

idioms.phrase: defeat the purpose / defeat the object
idioms.meaning: 违背初衷；失去原本意义；适得其反
idioms.example_en: Eating fast food right after working out defeats the purpose of exercising.
idioms.example_zh: 刚健身完就吃快餐完全违背了锻炼的初衷。

collocations.example_en: The champion narrowly defeated his opponent in the final round.
collocations.example_zh: 卫冕冠军在最后一轮险胜对手。

collocations.example_en: Parliament voted overwhelmingly to defeat the proposed bill.
collocations.example_zh: 议会以压倒性多数投票否决了该拟议法案。

collocations.example_en: The national team was soundly defeated in the semi-finals.
collocations.example_zh: 国家队在半决赛中惨遭痛击淘汰出局。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 撞上；猛烈撞击
phrasal_verbs.example_en: The driver lost control on the icy road and crashed into a tree.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 司机在结冰的路面上失去控制，撞上了一棵树。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 轰然倒塌；（梦想、体系等）瞬间破灭
phrasal_verbs.example_en: When the scandal broke, his carefully built career crashed down.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 丑闻曝光后，他苦心经营的事业轰然瓦解。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 精疲力竭倒头大睡；在比赛中被淘汰出局
phrasal_verbs.example_en: After working a 14-hour shift, he crashed out on the sofa.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 连续工作14个小时后，他倒在沙发上便昏睡过去。

idioms.meaning: 彻底失败；惨败收场
idioms.example_en: Despite massive funding, the new tech startup crashed and burned within a year.
idioms.example_zh: 尽管资金雄厚，这家新科技初创公司仍在一年内惨淡收场。

collocations.meaning: 不请自来地混入聚会；蹭派对
collocations.example_en: A few college students managed to crash the celebrity after-party.
collocations.example_zh: 几个大学生想方设法蹭进了名流举办的庆功派对。

collocations.example_en: Save your work frequently in case the software crashes unexpectedly.
collocations.example_zh: 经常保存工作内容，以防软件意外崩溃。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 用铁链锁住/拴住
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Don't forget to chain up your bicycle before going inside.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 进去之前别忘了用锁链把自行车锁好。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 把……用锁链连在一起；串联起来
phrasal_verbs.example_en: Several barrels were chained together to form a temporary floating barrier.
phrasal_verbs.example_zh: 几个水桶被用铁链连在一起，组成了一个临时水上屏障。

idioms.meaning: 被束缚在办公桌前；日复一日坐班受累
idioms.example_en: He quit his corporate job because he hated being chained to a desk all day.
idioms.example_zh: 他辞掉了大公司的工作，因为讨厌整天被拴在办公桌前。

collocations.meaning: 一支接一支抽烟；烟瘾极大
collocations.example_en: Anxious about the interview, he chain-smoked half a pack in twenty minutes.
collocations.example_zh: 由于对面试感到焦虑，他在二十分钟内接连抽了半包烟。

collocations.meaning: 把自己用链条锁在……上（多用于抗议活动）
collocations.example_en: Environmental activists chained themselves to the gates of the chemical plant.
collocations.example_zh: 环保示威者将自己锁在化工厂的大门上以示抗议。

phrasal_verbs.meaning: 冲走；冲垮；洗刷掉（痕迹、罪恶等）
